title.en: A teenager's death has prompted fresh calls for relationship education
title.zh: 一名青少年的死亡引发了对人际关系教育的新呼声

summary.en: A 16-year-old girl was found unresponsive at a home on Sydney's Northern Beaches on Sunday but died in hospital on Tuesday.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A teenage girl's tragic death, which has been reported as being linked to sexual choking, has sparked high-profile calls for broadened relationship education.

A 16-year-old girl was found unresponsive at an Elanora Heights home, on Sydney's Northern Beaches, on Sunday.

Police declined to confirm reports detectives were investigating sexual choking as a possible factor in the death.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Independent MP Zali Steggall mentioned the reports after a National Cabinet meeting on Wednesday affirmed a commitment to ending gender-based violence.

She said agreed measures were weak and pushed for more action, including a respectful relationship education campaign.

"My call for a national education campaign has been underscored by the devastating news today of the death of a 16-year-old Northern Beaches girl," Steggall said in a statement.

"My thoughts are with her family, friends and community at this incredibly difficult time."

Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek said there was no safe way to engage in choking.

"I'm sure I've said it to you in the past almost 60 per cent of young people report they've experienced choking in a recent sexual encounter," she told ABC Radio on Thursday morning.

"I can't say anything, obviously, about this tragic situation in NSW ... but in general terms, figures like that just concern me so deeply.

"There is no safe way of choking someone. Parents have to use this opportunity to talk to their young people."

A survey of 4702 Australians between 18 and 35 in 2024 found 57 per cent of respondents had been choked during sex at least once.

One-third of those respondents reported it occurring for the first time between 19 and 21.

The report's co-author noted choking in a sexual context could lead to serious brain injuries, including memory loss and issues with problem-solving.

"It doesn't matter if there are no apparent injuries, or whether the person consented," Professor Heather Douglas said at the time.

"Brain injury can also be incremental — getting a bit worse with each choking — and the person may not know they have suffered a brain injury. The effects of repeated strangling are insidious and build over time."

title.en: Australia wants more data centres. A disagreement over power sources stands in the way
title.zh: 澳大利亚希望增加数据中心数量，但能源来源问题阻碍了发展

summary.en: Proposed legislation requiring data centre developers to supply their own renewable energy sources has met with opposition. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has indicated a more flexible approach after Queensland and the Northern Territory resisted standards for new data centre developments to use renewables instead of...
summary.zh: 要求数据中心开发商提供自有可再生能源的拟议立法遭到了反对。在昆士兰州和北领地抵制要求新建数据中心使用可再生能源而非煤炭和天然气的标准后，总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯表示将采取更灵活的做法。

body.en:
Two jurisdictions have forced the prime minister to back down on a major policy that would have required all new AI data centres to be powered by renewable energy rather than coal and gas.

Anthony Albanese left the door open at a meeting of the nation's leaders on Wednesday to a more "flexible" approach as Queensland and the Northern Territory refused to agree to standards requiring them to use renewables for new data centre developments.

He announced the agreement on the AI laws alongside domestic violence measures and firearm reforms following a meeting of National Cabinet in Sydney.

"We want to make sure that in attracting investment, we don't have eight different systems operating around the country," he said on Wednesday.

"That's why we came to a common position, which recognises that all states aren't exactly the same, and that was accommodated in the way that we normally do in a flexible way."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

South Australian Premier Peter Malinauskas said the nation's leaders agreed renewables would be the main form of energy to power future data centres in Australia.

"Acknowledging that there are different circumstances through the fact that in Queensland, for instance, they have state-owned generation," he told ABC's 7.30 on Wednesday.

"So there's no need for the federal government to use its powers that it has to override what states want."

Gregor Verbic, an energy expert at Sydney University, said the national grid was facing the imminent closure of multiple coal-fired power stations.

"(It) will leave a huge gap in the generation capacity, and we are not building new capacity fast enough," he told the Australian Associated Press news agency.

The federal government has proposed legislation to force data centre developers to provide their own renewable energy source.

Both the Queensland and NT governments provided considerable pushback, with the final national agreement failing to mention renewable energy directly.

Verbic said ensuring the energy brought online is renewable is essential to meet Australia's emissions reduction targets.

Albanese flagged draft legislation will be introduced by the end of 2026, with the aim for it to be passed in early 2027.

title.en: Albanese reveals humanitarian visa intake won't be cut, amid migration reform questions
title.zh: 阿尔巴内塞透露，由于移民改革问题，人道主义签证的接收量不会减少

summary.en: Labor has been signalling an upcoming shift in migration policy, as the prime minister quelled speculation on a key detail.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The Albanese government has denied plans to slash Australia’s humanitarian intake by a third, after reports the cut was being considered as part of a broader push to reduce net overseas migration.

On Thursday, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said in a statement the government's 20,000 humanitarian placements would "be continued in future years, consistent with Australia’s humanitarian commitments".

The statement followed reporting on Thursday morning by The Australian Financial Review newspaper that Labor appeared poised to reduce humanitarian placements from 20,000 to 13,750 at the start of the next financial year and that it had factored the decrease into migration forecasts.

A spokesman for Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke told SBS News earlier on Thursday that the final decision on next year's humanitarian intake had not yet been made and linked the process to next year's budget. At the time he did not rule out cuts.

But in his statement to SBS News, Albanese said the existing figure "remains government policy".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In the wake of multiple international conflicts around the world, Labor has made a series of increases to the humanitarian intake, pushing it to its current high.

The confusion comes as the government is anticipated to announce an overhaul of its migration policy.

Labor had been expected to reveal details in a National Press Club address by Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke earlier this month, but the speech was cancelled after Burke failed to secure cabinet agreement on the best approach.

Since then, Albanese has refused to give further updates, telling ABC radio on Tuesday that there are a "series of plans in place" but there is still "more work to do" to finalise them. He declined to set a timeframe for immigration announcements, saying only that they would come at "appropriate times".

Migration targets have been the source of recent public debate, with One Nation pushing a tough anti-migration stance and gaining in the polls.

Both major parties have sought to restrict their own immigration policies while denying that this is in response to the minor party's growing popularity.

Opposition leader Angus Taylor has said the Coalition will cap net overseaos migration (NOM) at or below the number of homes built in Australia the previous year. Current building rates suggest their figure would be under 180,000; however, the Coalition is yet to announce where they would restrict immigration to reach that figure.

body.en: The government announced on Friday solicitor Melissa Pang has been appointed as the new chairperson of the Radio Television Hong Kong (RTHK) Board of Advisors, succeeding Lam Tai-fai. Ten incumbent members have been reappointed, and two new members have been appointed to the board. All appointments take effect on September 1, for a term of two years. The newly appointed members are Chan Cho-biu and Li Tsz-shu. "I believe that with Ms Pang's wealth of experience in public services, she will be able to lead the Board in offering invaluable advice to the Director of Broadcasting and assisting RTHK in fulfilling its missions and public objectives as set out in the Charter of RTHK," Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau said in a statement. Yau also thanked Lam for his contributions as chairperson since 2020 as well as the two outgoing members Ronald Chiu and Thomas So for their six years of service on the board. Edited by Aaron Tam

summary.en: Tiananmen vigil activists Chow Hang-tung, Lee Cheuk-yan and Albert Ho, and the now-defunct pro-democracy group they led, the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China, returned to court on Friday for mitigation proceedings. Chow, Lee and the group...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Tiananmen vigil activists Chow Hang-tung, Lee Cheuk-yan and Albert Ho, and the now-defunct pro-democracy group they led, the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China, returned to court on Friday for mitigation proceedings. Chow Hang-tung. Photo: Candice Chau/HKFP. Chow, Lee and the group were found guilty last Friday of inciting subversion, an offence under the national security law. Ho pleaded guilty when the trial began in January. The activists face up to 10 years in jail. Chow, a barrister, represented herself in the trial. She was only able to read out the first few sentences of her mitigation statement on Friday before being stopped by the judge. Below is her full mitigation statement , which is uploaded on her Patreon page. 1. The 206-page judgment, after all, boils down to saying that pursuing democracy is a crime. 2. I find it entirely unpalatable that any political party can barter away a nation’s sovereignty, claim to represent the will of the people, appoint itself as the sole authority, and then insist that citizens are legally bound to uphold its self-fashioned throne. A law of this nature is nothing more than a euphemism for tyranny. 3. Believing that dictatorship is wrong and democracy is right – if that isn’t a belief, then what is? Even if the courts and the government attempt to claim, like a chanted mantra, that they are not judging beliefs, they cannot change the reality: under this judgment, anyone who believes in the principle of ‘ending one-party dictatorship’ has nowhere left to stand. In the eyes of this brand of ‘law’, holding such a thought inherently contravenes the Constitution – rendering it unlawful, an original sin. Even when we engage in entirely legitimate acts, such as commemorating June 4 th , it becomes a crime simply because of the perceived ‘impropriety’ of our thoughts. 4. Yet the law cannot govern what a person thinks. Not only is it incapable of doing so, but when it openly defies the human conscience, it is the law itself that ultimately suffers – forfeiting its very legitimacy. 5. People must draw a line somewhere, and the law must do the same. This marks one of the most fundamental distinctions between a democracy and an autocracy: genuine rule of law simply cannot survive under a dictatorship. When the Court completely disregard the underlying facts and the boundaries between right and wrong in the face of demands to ‘end one-party dictatorship’, choosing instead to blindly enforce the will of the regime and a supposed duty to obey, its conduct become as absurd as claiming a duty to execute Jewish people in Nazi Germany. Such an approach strips the law of its essential pursuit of justice, reducing it to little more than an instrument of political expediency....
body.zh: 天安门守夜活动人士周恒东、李卓人和何俊仁，以及他们领导的现已解散的民主团体“香港支持中国爱国民主运动联盟”，于周五返回法庭进行减刑程序。周恒东.照片：Candice Chau/HKFP。周、李和该团伙上周五被判犯有煽动颠覆罪，这是国家安全法规定的犯罪行为。一月份审判开始时，何先生承认有罪。这些活动人士面临最高 10 年的监禁。周是一名大律师，在审判中代表自己。周五，她只能读出缓刑声明的前几句话，然后就被法官制止了。以下是她的完整缓解声明，已上传到她的 Patreon 页面上。 1. 长达206页的判决书归根结底是说追求民主是犯罪。 2. 我认为任何政党都可以拿一个国家的主权来交换，声称自己代表人民的意志，将自己指定为唯一的权威，然后坚持要求公民有法律义务维护其自封的王位，这是完全令人难以接受的。这种性质的法律无非是暴政的委婉说法。 3. 相信独裁是错误的，民主是正确的——如果这不是信仰，那什么才是？即使法院和政府试图像口号一样声称他们不是在审判信仰，也无法改变现实：在这种审判下，任何相信“结束一党独裁”原则的人都没有立足之地。在这种“法律”的眼中，持有这样的想法本质上就违反了宪法——使其非法，成为原罪。即使我们从事完全合法的行为，例如纪念 6 月 4 日，它也仅仅因为我们的想法被认为是“不当”而成为犯罪行为。 4. 然而，法律不能管辖一个人的想法。它不仅无法做到这一点，而且当它公然违背人类良心时，最终受苦的是法律本身——丧失了其合法性。 5.人们必须在某处划清界限，法律也必须这样做。这标志着民主与专制之间最根本的区别之一：真正的法治根本无法在独裁统治下生存。当法院在“结束一党独裁”的诉求面前完全无视事实真相和是非界限，选择盲目执行政权意志和所谓的服从义务时，其行为就变得与声称有义务在纳粹德国处决犹太人一样荒谬。这种做法剥夺了法律对正义的本质追求，使其沦为政治权宜之计的工具……

title.en: 'HK to see more red and black heat stress warnings'
title.zh: “香港将看到更多红色和黑色热应激警告”

summary.en: The Labour Department said a refined heat stress at work warning system will be more sensitive towards extreme hot weather. Two new conditions were added to the system starting on Friday to raise its sensitivity in triggering a warning, meaning there could be more red and black...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The Labour Department said a refined heat stress at work warning system will be more sensitive towards extreme hot weather. Two new conditions were added to the system starting on Friday to raise its sensitivity in triggering a warning, meaning there could be more red and black heat stress at work warnings going forward. When the Observatory issues an extreme heat alert, the amber warning will be issued immediately, and the threshold for raising the warning level will be lowered to allow for an earlier activation. In addition, if temperatures reach 35 degrees Celsius or above at 40 percent of the weather forecaster’s 39 monitoring stations, the warning will be automatically raised by one level. Speaking on an RTHK radio programme, Deputy Commissioner (Occupational Safety and Health) Ivanhoe Chang noted there was a need to adjust the system after record-high temperatures were recorded earlier this month. He said the city will see more days of higher warning levels under the enhanced system. “We hope that through adjustments to the warning levels, the warnings will more effectively reflect relevant heat stress risks under abnormally high temperatures in particular,” he said. “We think that overall, if the weather conditions in the future is similar to the trend in the past three years, there could be four to seven days of red warnings, while there would be one to two days of a black warning.” With the refinements, the system will continue to rely on the Hong Kong Heat Index that takes into consideration the temperature, humidity, wind speed and solar radiation. When asked why the department did not opt for the Wet Bulb Global Temperature measurement system, Chang said that both the index and WBGT have its own advantages. As Hong Kong’s summer is relatively humid, the index that sees a higher proportion in humidity can better reflect the city’s subtropical conditions, he said. But Chang added that the department is open to the usage of other evaluation tools. It will also keep monitoring the operations of the refined system to see if further adjustments are needed, he added. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 美国劳工部表示，完善的工作热应激预警系统将对极端炎热天气更加敏感。从周五开始，系统中添加了两个新条件，以提高触发警告的灵敏度，这意味着未来可能会出现更多的红色和黑色工作热应激警告。当天文台发出酷热警报时，会立即发出黄色警告，并降低提高警告级别的门槛，以便较早启动。此外，如果气象部门39个监测站中有40%的气温达到35摄氏度或以上，预警将自动提升一级。副专员（职业安全及健康）张艾文豪在香港电台电台节目中表示，本月早些时候录得创纪录的高温后，有必要调整系统。他说，在增强的系统下，该市将出现更多天的更高警报级别。他说：“我们希望通过调整预警级别，能够更有效地反映异常高温下的相关热应激风险。” “我们认为，总体而言，如果未来的天气状况与过去三年的趋势相似，红色预警可能会持续四到七天，黑色预警可能会持续一到两天。”经过改进后，该系统将继续依赖香港炎热指数，该指数会考虑温度、湿度、风速和太阳辐射。当被问及为何部门不选择湿球全球温度测量系统时，张表示，该指数和WBGT都有各自的优势。他表示，由于香港夏季相对潮湿，湿度占比较高的指数更能反映香港的亚热带气候。但张补充说，该部门对使用其他评估工具持开放态度。他补充说，还将继续监控完善系统的运行情况，看看是否需要进一步调整。谭咏麟编辑

summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Chinese University Vice‑Chancellor Dennis Lo is calling on the government to increase its financial support for university development in the Northern Metropolis, saying more funding would give institutions greater certainty for future planning. Speaking on RTHK's "On Broadcast Drive" programme, he said the Chinese University's ranking and reputation are strong, but its scale is too small. He believes the Northern Metropolis could help the university expand. "Right now, we're like a boutique hotel – our reputation and the work we do are very good, but our size just isn't big enough. So I think the Northern Metropolis is one way we can expand our scale," he said. "I know the government has set aside HK$10 billion in loans for universities to build campuses [in the Northern Metropolis]. But I hope that amount can be increased – or even go beyond loans, maybe with some grants – so that we can plan more easily for the future." Meanwhile, Lo warned that the rapid development of artificial intelligence may be stifling scientific creativity, saying that while AI is powerful, it also risks reducing human originality. The CUHK vice chancellor said he has heard that some researchers now simply ask AI for ideas and work through a list of options until they find something. Describing himself as an "old‑fashioned" scientist, Lo said he feels this takes the fun out of science. "In the past, when I did research, I would think things through slowly and come up with ideas that were different from others. But in the future, if everyone just uses the same few AI tools, your imagination could be boxed in,” he warned. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 中文大学校长卢仁伟呼吁政府增加对北方都会大学发展的财政支持，并表示更多的资金将使各机构的未来规划更有确定性。他在香港电台《广播之路》节目中表示，中文大学的排名和声誉很高，但规模太小。他相信北方都市可以帮助大学扩张。 “现在，我们就像一家精品酒店，我们的声誉和所做的工作都很好，但我们的规模还不够大。所以我认为北方都市是我们扩大规模的一种方式，”他说。 “我知道政府已拨出100亿港元的贷款，供大学（在北部大都市）建设校园。但我希望这笔金额可以增加，甚至超越贷款，也许还有一些赠款，以便我们可以更轻松地规划未来。”与此同时，罗警告说，人工智能的快速发展可能会扼杀科学创造力，尽管人工智能很强大，但它也有降低人类原创性的风险。香港中文大学副校长表示，他听说一些研究人员现在只是向人工智能询问想法，然后通过一系列选项进行研究，直到找到答案。罗将自己描述为一名“老式”科学家，他认为这剥夺了科学的乐趣。 “过去做研究时，我会慢慢思考，提出与别人不同的想法。但在未来，如果每个人都只使用同样的几个人工智能工具，你的想象力可能会受到限制，”他警告说。谭咏麟编辑

title.en: Hong Kong enhances heat stress warning system after chorus of criticism, but rules still not binding
title.zh: 香港在一片批评声中加强了热应激预警系统，但规则仍未具有约束力

summary.en: Hong Kong’s Labour Department has unveiled changes to its heat stress warning system following criticism that the existing thresholds meant no alerts were issued despite record-breaking temperatures this month. The department said in a statement on Thursday that the Heat Stress...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Hong Kong’s Labour Department has unveiled changes to its heat stress warning system following criticism that the existing thresholds meant no alerts were issued despite record-breaking temperatures this month. The department said in a statement on Thursday that the Heat Stress at Work Warning (HSWW) system will feature two new trigger conditions from Friday to better protect workers in high-temperature environments. However, the rules are still not binding upon employers. An outdoor worker in Hong Kong’s summer. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Under these changes, the monitoring threshold for triggering higher-level warnings will be lowered when an “Extremely Hot Weather” Special Alert from the Hong Kong Observatory (HKO) is in effect. When temperatures across Hong Kong reach 35 degrees Celsius or above, the system will lower the threshold and automatically raise the warning level by one step – from amber to red, or from red to black. System under fire Earlier this month, the HSWW system received criticism after the alert level remained at amber even as the city experienced its hottest day in 143 years on August 9. Labour Department. File photo: Candice Chau/HKFP. Former HKO director Lam Chiu-ying wrote on Facebook that it was “truly baffling” how record-breaking temperatures had only activated the lowest-tier Heat Stress at Work Warning. He noted reports that the amber warning had been triggered more than 200 times since the system was introduced in May 2023, while red and black warnings had never been activated. Two more former HKO chiefs later joined calls to revamp the system. They pointed out that the Labour Department uses the HKO’s Heat Index (HI) as a reference for the HSWW – a “mismatch” since the HI is intended for the general public rather than outdoor workers. Instead, they urged the department to adopt the wet-bulb globe temperature, an internationally recognised measure of environmental heat that accounts for not only air temperature but also humidity, heat radiation, and air movement. Hong Kong saw a record-breaking heatwave in summer 2026. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The department has not yet adopted this suggestion, but says it will consider it in the future. “After the launch of the enhanced system, the Labour Department will continue to review the operation of the system and make improvements, such as studying whether to include other monitoring data, for example, the Wet Bulb Globe Temperature, as one of the indicators of the system,” the department’s statement on Thursday said. Further changes urged In response to the new amendments, a local charity supporting victims of workplace accidents said it believes the lowered thresholds will improve the HSWW system’s sensitivity,...
body.zh: 香港劳工处公布了对其热应激警报系统的修改，此前有人批评现有的阈值意味着尽管本月气温破纪录，但仍没有发布警报。该部门在周四的一份声明中表示，工作热应激警告（HSWW）系统将从周五开始提供两个新的触发条件，以更好地保护高温环境下的工人。然而，这些规则对雇主仍然没有约束力。香港夏天的一名户外工作者。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。根据这些变化，当香港天文台发出的“酷热天气”特别警报生效时，触发更高级别警报的监测阈值将会降低。当全港气温达到摄氏35度或以上时，系统会降低阈值，并自动将警报级别提升一级——从琥珀色升为红色，或从红色升为黑色。系统受到攻击 本月早些时候，尽管该市在 8 月 9 日经历了 143 年来最热的一天，但 HSWW 系统仍受到了批评，因为警报级别仍处于琥珀色。劳工部。档案照片：Candice Chau/HKFP。香港天文台前台长林超英在脸书上写道，破纪录的气温竟然引发了最低级别的工作热应激警告，这“实在令人费解”。他指出，有报道称，自 2023 年 5 月推出该系统以来，黄色警报已被触发超过 200 次，而红色和黑色警报从未被激活。后来又有两名前香港天文台局长加入呼吁改革该系统。他们指出，劳工处使用香港天文台的炎热指数（HI）作为HSWW的参考——这是“不匹配的”，因为HI是针对普通公众而不是户外工人的。相反，他们敦促该部门采用湿球温度，这是一种国际公认的环境热量衡量标准，不仅考虑空气温度，还考虑湿度、热辐射和空气流动。 2026 年夏季，香港遭遇破纪录的热浪。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。该部门尚未采纳这一建议，但表示将来会考虑。 “加强版系统推出后，劳工部将继续检讨系统的运作情况并作出改进，例如研究是否纳入其他监测数据，例如湿球温度，作为系统的指标之一，”劳工部周四的声明称。敦促进一步改变针对新的修正案，一家支持工作场所事故受害者的当地慈善机构表示，它相信降低的门槛将提高 HSWW 系统的敏感性，...

title.en: Mid-Autumn lantern spectacle to dazzle visitors
title.zh: 中秋彩灯奇观让游客眼花缭乱

summary.en: A brand-new lantern exhibition showcasing cultural elements from around the world is set to wow locals and tourists at Victoria Park next month, as Hong Kong gets ready to ring in Mid-Autumn Festival. The inaugural International Lantern Spectacular organised by the Hong Kong...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A brand-new lantern exhibition showcasing cultural elements from around the world is set to wow locals and tourists at Victoria Park next month, as Hong Kong gets ready to ring in Mid-Autumn Festival. The inaugural International Lantern Spectacular organised by the Hong Kong Tourism Board features thousands of distinctive lanterns from 20 countries and regions, under the theme of "reunion". The exhibition's centrepiece will be the World Lantern Boulevard, where visitors will be treated to silk lanterns from South Korea, the multi-coloured patchwork lanterns of Brazil, and Polish lanterns incorporating traditional folk paper-cutting techniques. The Tourism Board has also invited a team of craftsmen from Nanjing to set up four giant Qinhuai lanterns that will be built with a traditional technique dating back 1,700 years, and is inscribed on the national list of Intangible Cultural Heritage. Another pavilion will showcase hundreds of lanterns handcrafted by local artisans, taking up the shape of rabbits, star fruits and goldfish. The exhibition runs from September 17 to 27, and coincides with the ⁠⁠Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival held by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department in Causeway Bay every year. Revellers are also encouraged to head to nearby Tai Hang for the Fire Dragon Dance between September 24 and 26. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 随着香港即将迎来中秋佳节，一场展示世界各地文化元素的全新灯展将于下个月在维多利亚公园为当地人和游客带来惊喜。香港旅游发展局主办的首届国际彩灯汇演以“团圆”为主题，展示了来自20个国家和地区的数千个各具特色的彩灯。展览的核心是世界灯笼大道，游客将在这里看到来自韩国的丝绸灯笼、巴西的多彩拼凑灯笼以及融合了传统民间剪纸技术的波兰灯笼。旅游局还邀请了来自南京的工匠团队，以1700年前的传统工艺制作了四盏巨型秦淮灯，并被列入国家非物质文化遗产名录。另一个展馆将展示数百个由当地工匠手工制作的灯笼，形状为兔子、杨桃和金鱼。展览于9月17日至27日举行，恰逢康乐及文化事务署每年在铜锣湾举办的中秋彩灯会。我们还鼓励狂欢者于 9 月 24 日至 26 日期间前往附近的大坑观看舞火龙。编辑：谭咏麟

summary.en: Plans to hike fares for Hong Kong’s iconic Star Ferry must take into account its status as an “important asset” as well as the public’s capacity to bear the higher costs, a transport advisor to the government has said. The advisor’s comments came amid the ferry operator’s...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Plans to hike fares for Hong Kong’s iconic Star Ferry must take into account its status as an “important asset” as well as the public’s capacity to bear the higher costs, a transport advisor to the government has said. Hong Kong’s Star Ferry. File photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. The advisor’s comments came amid the ferry operator’s application to increase fees by 30 per cent, which was publicised last month. Speaking to reporters on Thursday, Transport Advisory Committee chair Wong Sze-chun said that he and other advisors would balance the needs of the ferry operator with those of the public. “The Star Ferry is an important asset to Hong Kong, so its ability to serve the public is quite vital. We must ensure the continuation of this service,” Wong said in Cantonese after a committee meeting to discuss the proposed fare hike. “At the same time, we have considered the public’s level of acceptance regarding fare increases and their affordability,” he added. “These are the primary factors we weighed during our meeting.” Hong Kong’s Star Ferry. File photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. The Star Ferry runs two cross-harbour routes between Tsim Sha Tsui and Wan Chai and Tsim Sha Tsui and Central. The proposal would see adult single weekday fares rise from HK$5 to HK$6.50, and weekend and public holiday fares go up from HK$6.50 to HK$8.50, according to a Transport and Logistics Bureau submission to the legislature last month. The 138-year-old company cited plans to replace the engines of its vessels in the latter half of this year, the cost of which is estimated to top HK$10 million per ship. It also brought up vessel maintenance and repair costs, rising staff costs, fuel expenditure, interest payments from debt, pier operating costs, and losses exceeding HK$100 million between 2018 and 2023.
body.zh: 政府的一名交通顾问表示，提高香港标志性天星小轮票价的计划必须考虑到其作为“重要资产”的地位以及公众承受更高成本的能力。香港的天星小轮。资料照片：Kelly Ho/HKFP。该顾问发表上述评论之际，轮渡运营商申请将费用增加 30%，该申请于上个月公布。交通咨询委员会主席黄思俊周四对记者表示，他和其他顾问将平衡渡轮运营商与公众的需求。 “天星小轮是香港的重要资产，因此它为公众提供服务的能力非常重要。我们必须确保这项服务能够持续下去。”黄在一次讨论票价上涨建议的委员会会议后用粤语说道。他补充说：“与此同时，我们考虑了公众对票价上涨的接受程度及其承受能力。” “这些是我们在会议期间权衡的主要因素。”香港的天星小轮。资料照片：Kelly Ho/HKFP。天星小轮有两条跨海航线来往尖沙咀与湾仔及尖沙咀与中环。根据运输及物流局上个月向立法机关提交的文件显示，该提议将使成人单人工作日票价从 5 港元上涨至 6.50 港元，周末和公众假期票价从 6.50 港元上涨至 8.50 港元。这家拥有138年历史的公司表示，计划在今年下半年更换船舶发动机，估计每艘船的成本将超过1,000万港元。它还提出了船舶维护和修理成本、员工成本上升、燃油支出、债务利息支付、码头运营成本以及2018年至2023年期间超过1亿港元的损失。

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? title.en: 'The flood took everything': Nepal survivors describe horror of loved ones being swept away
title.zh: “洪水夺走了一切”：尼泊尔幸存者描述亲人被冲走的恐惧

summary.en: One woman says her father, mother, sister and sister's children were carried away before her eyes.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Survivors of massive flash floods in Nepal have recounted how they saw their loved ones disappear into torrents of mud.

At least 469 people have died and several hundred others are missing after floods wiped out entire villages on the border of Nepal and Tibet on Wednesday, with a force so powerful seismologists initially identified it as an earthquake.

Rescuers trudged through thick mud and debris on Thursday as Nepalese authorities rushed to bring aid and relief supplies to the affected areas.

"My family members were swept away by the flood in front of my eyes," Kalpana Malla from Nepal's Nuwakot district told the BBC.

Malla said her father, mother, sister and sister's children were all claimed by the disaster.

"They could not escape the flood; there was no chance at all," she said. "This flood took everything, but my son and I climbed the rooftop of a house and survived but couldn't explain how."

He said he had given his phone to his sister so she could keep in touch, but the mobile was no longer reachable.

Another woman, Goma Pandit, said she had lost her buffaloes and all her other cattle.

"My farmland is also swept away. Ten sacks of mustard seeds, tons of corn and rice paddy are all gone. Nothing is left."

At Kathmandu's TU Teaching Hospital, families of those missing in the floods wait anxiously for updates.

Holding up her phone, Ram Khumari Shrestha says: "This is my husband. He was off to Rasuwa as a part of his driving job. He was in contact with me until 8 pm yesterday.

"But I couldn't call him this morning. The phone was switched off," she told the BBC.

Mani Shrestha Bishwa was also camped out at the hospital on Wednesday night, hoping to hear from his younger brother, cousin, uncle and friend.

Trekking guide Sonam Dorjee missed the flood in his home village of Rasiwa Syafru by about an hour. He had left at 08:00 local time.

As he was driving to Kathmandu, Dorjee told the BBC he had heard the sound of floods gushing into their village.

"It [sounded] like an earthquake," he said. "My house has collapsed... I have seen a photo."

Dorjee said his sister, Dechen Tamang, was missing, along with her husband and several other family members.

"Many survivors are now left without homes and they need emergency rescue and evacuation, as well as food, temporary accommodation and medical support."

He is praying his sister is found alive. "There is a 10% chance, we hope," he said.
body.zh: 尼泊尔大规模山洪爆发的幸存者讲述了他们如何看到亲人消失在泥浆洪流中。 周三，洪水摧毁了尼泊尔和西藏边境的整个村庄，造成至少 469 人死亡，数百人失踪，其威力如此强大，地震学家最初将其确定为地震。 周四，尼泊尔当局紧急向受影响地区运送援助和救灾物资，救援人员艰难地穿过厚厚的泥浆和废墟。 来自尼泊尔努瓦科特地区的卡尔帕纳·马拉告诉英国广播公司：“我的家人在我眼前被洪水冲走。” 马拉说，她的父亲、母亲、姐姐和姐姐的孩子都在这场灾难中丧生。 “他们无法逃离洪水；根本没有机会，”她说。 “这场洪水夺走了一切，但我和儿子爬上了屋顶，活了下来，但无法解释如何活下来。” 他说，他已将手机交给了妹妹，以便她能保持联系，但手机已无法接通。 另一位名叫戈马·潘迪特的妇女说，她失去了她的水牛和所有其他牛。 “我的田地也被冲走了，十袋芥菜籽、成吨的玉米、稻田都没有了，什么都没有了。” 在加德满都的工业大学教学医院，洪水中失踪人员的家人焦急地等待最新消息。 拉姆·库马里·什雷斯塔 (Ram Khumari Shrestha) 举起手机说道：“这是我的丈夫。他去拉苏瓦是为了完成驾驶工作。昨天晚上 8 点之前他一直与我联系。” “但今天早上我无法给他打电话。电话已关机，”她告诉英国广播公司。 周三晚上，马尼·什雷斯塔·比什瓦 (Mani Shrestha Bishwa) 也在医院露营，希望听到他弟弟、表弟、叔叔和朋友的消息。 徒步向导索南·多吉 (Sonam Dorjee) 比家乡拉西瓦·沙夫鲁 (Rasiwa Syafru) 的洪水晚了大约一个小时。他于当地时间08:00离开。 当多吉开车前往加德满都时，他告诉英国广播公司，他听到洪水涌入他们村庄的声音。 “这（听起来）就像一场地震，”他说。 “我的房子倒塌了……我看过照片。” 多吉说，他的妹妹德钦·塔芒（Dechen Tamang）、她的丈夫和其他几名家庭成员失踪了。 “许多幸存者现在无家可归，他们需要紧急救援和疏散，以及食物、临时住宿和医疗支持。” 他正在祈祷他的妹妹还活着。 “我们希望有 10% 的机会，”他说。

title.en: People with more mobility in the labor market experience less discrimination
title.zh: 劳动力市场流动性较大的人受到的歧视较少

summary.en: Employees who can easily change jobs are less likely to experience workplace discrimination. When dealing with a discriminatory employer, job mobility acts as an important incentive: If you can leave more easily, your employer will often make greater efforts to combat...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Employees who can easily change jobs are less likely to experience workplace discrimination. When dealing with a discriminatory employer, job mobility acts as an important incentive: If you can leave more easily, your employer will often make greater efforts to combat discrimination and retain you. That's what André van Hoorn writes in Economic and Industrial Democracy.

Unfortunately, workplace discrimination still occurs, but in practice, not every person within a vulnerable group is affected to the same extent. Van Hoorn investigated differences within groups, such as employees with a migrant background or a disability. However, the research shows that even within these groups, some people experience discrimination more frequently than others. A key reason for this is more limited labor mobility.

Van Hoorn analyzed data from more than 20,000 employees in 32 countries. Nearly one in five workers (18.4%) reported experiencing workplace discrimination over a five-year period. The economist mapped out how and why individuals within different groups experience discrimination. Groups with lower labor mobility appear to be affected more frequently. "People who can switch employers more easily experience discrimination less often," Van Hoorn explains.

"The data show that people who are stuck in their jobs are more likely to face discrimination. If you can leave easily, an employer often realizes this too. And if you're a mobile worker experiencing an unpleasant situation, your employer will be more inclined to intervene and create a better working environment. Because if the situation doesn't improve, your employer knows that you'll soon be able to move on to a more inclusive workplace. As a result, external job mobility acts both as a shield with your current employer and as an escape route to a new job."

Mobility is determined by various factors. Accessibility plays a role: If there are many companies in the area offering similar vacancies, you're more likely to leave. Van Hoorn said, "If the government invests in better public transportation services, this increases the mobility of these groups. With more trains and better buses, you can reach more employers."

Your own skills also play a part: The more skills you have, the more sought-after you are by more companies—and by your current employer. "It certainly doesn't hurt to make yourself indispensable to an organization. But even better is to develop precisely those skills that make you highly attractive in the labor market in general. Then an employer will also go to greater lengths to retain you."

title.en: Videos capture humpback whales stopping to snack as they migrate along Australia's coast
title.zh: 视频捕捉到座头鲸沿着澳大利亚海岸迁徙时停下来吃零食的画面

summary.en: The southern humpback whale migration is in full swing. Tens of thousands of whales are now making their journey from warm Australian waters in the north to their cold feeding grounds in Antarctica.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The southern humpback whale migration is in full swing. Tens of thousands of whales are now making their journey from warm Australian waters in the north to their cold feeding grounds in Antarctica.

In a new study published in Marine Mammal Science , we investigated humpback whale feeding behavior on the east coast of Australia using information from citizen science and social media. We found that mid-latitude feeding is a common and widespread strategy among humpback whales.

This discovery challenges a long-held assumption about where and when whales feed. It could also help us better protect these magnificent animals.

This theory suggests that the whales spend summer feeding on krill in Antarctica to build up fat reserves, then travel thousands of kilometers to low-latitude breeding grounds to mate and give birth. Warm tropical waters are nutrient-poor, offering little opportunity to feed.

Historically, whaling and stranding records also supported this "feast or famine" theory, with the vast majority of humpback whales caught during mid-latitude migration in Australian waters having empty stomachs.

It was widely assumed that they relied solely on their fat stores to sustain their migration, mating and the intense energetic demands of nursing newborn calves.

Conducting long-term, large-scale systematic research surveys across thousands of kilometers of the Australian coastline isn't feasible because of the high cost involved.

Instead, like other researchers turning to public photos and footage , we sourced information about feeding events from social media.

We searched platforms such as Facebook and Instagram for public posts from whale-watching companies, drone pilots and dedicated whale enthusiasts. Only posts featuring clear visual evidence of specific feeding behaviors were included.

This included whales opening their mouths, lunging through the water column with expanded ventral pleats (the accordion-like grooves that cover a whale's underside), bubble-net feeding or surfacing directly through dense schools of baitfish.

Our search resulted in 199 distinct feeding observations, representing an estimated 1,417 individual humpback whales documented feeding in Australian waters between 2013 and 2024.

Major feeding hotspots included the NSW south coast—in particular, near Eden, Merimbula and Bermagui—which accounted for 45% of all verified feeding events. Other hotspots included eastern and southern Tasmania and the Victorian coast, which accounted for 28% and 12% of the records, respectively.

title.en: Bank holiday weekend to see more thunderstorms and rain
title.zh: 银行假日周末将出现更多雷暴和降雨

summary.en: The weather will remain unsettled across the next few days with showers, longer spells of rain and thunderstorms all likely at times across the weekend.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Most of the UK is finally getting some rain, in time for the bank holiday weekend.

The weather will remain unsettled across the next few days with showers, longer spells of rain and thunderstorms all likely at times.

By Monday the focus of the wet weather is likely to be across Scotland, with sunny spells developing elsewhere.

The RAC estimates that 20 million trips by car will be made across the weekend in what could be challenging driving conditions.

A yellow weather warning issued by the Met Office remains in place for a stretch of eastern England until 07:00 BST on Friday.

People in this area could see frequent lightning, hail and strong, gusty winds in addition to heavy rain.

For the rest of the day expect showers and longer spells of rain, with heavy downpours and thunderstorms possible, especially across western Scotland, Wales and north-west England.

Some of this wet weather could spread east later, with thunderstorms possible across north-east England and eastern Scotland.

After the recent warm and humid conditions, temperatures by Friday will feel fresher.

Expect around 20–23C (68 -73F) in England and Wales, and 16–20C (61-68F) in Scotland and Northern Ireland.

Saturday will remain unsettled, with sunny spells mixed with heavy showers and possible thunderstorms, particularly across England and Wales.

Fresh westerly winds will make it feel blustery, with highs of 18-22C (64-72F) in England and Wales and 16-19C (61-66F) further north.

Sunday and Bank Holiday Monday - for England and Wales - will stay changeable, with further heavy showers, longer spells of rain and a risk of thunderstorms once again.

Monday is likely to be wettest across Scotland, while England and Wales can expect a mix of sunshine and showers before further rain moves in from the west.

Stronger winds are also possible across southern parts of the UK, with temperatures generally ranging from 16C to 23C (61-73F).

Overall, the late August bank holiday weekend looks set to be cooler, windier and wetter than the hot and dry conditions we've experienced for much of this record-breaking summer.

There will still be some pleasant sunny spells between showers, with temperatures potentially reaching the low 20s in the south-east.

However, with low pressure remaining close to the UK, there is currently little sign of a return to prolonged hot and settled weather.

The outlook for early September suggests further changeable conditions, with a mixture of sunshine and showers and temperatures generally close to or slightly below average.

Whatever your plans for the weekend, you can keep up to date with the forecast by checking the BBC Weather website and app .
body.zh: 英国大部分地区终于在银行假日周末迎来降雨。 未来几天天气仍不稳定，时有阵雨、较长时间的降雨和雷暴。 到周一，潮湿天气的重点可能会出现在整个苏格兰，其他地方也会出现阳光明媚的天气。 RAC 估计，整个周末将有 2000 万次汽车出行，驾驶条件可能具有挑战性。 英国气象局对英格兰东部部分地区发布的黄色天气警报持续到英国夏令时周五 07:00。 除了大雨外，该地区的人们还会经常看到闪电、冰雹和强阵风。 当天剩余时间预计将有阵雨和较长时间的降雨，可能有大雨和雷暴，特别是在苏格兰西部、威尔士和英格兰西北部。 部分潮湿天气可能稍后向东扩散，英格兰东北部和苏格兰东部可能出现雷暴。 经过最近的温暖潮湿的天气后，周五的气温将会感觉更加清新。 英格兰和威尔士预计气温约为 20–23C (68 -73F)，苏格兰和北爱尔兰预计气温为 16–20C (61-68F)。 周六仍将不稳定，晴朗的天气夹杂着大阵雨和可能的雷暴，特别是在英格兰和威尔士地区。 清新的西风将带来大风，英格兰和威尔士的最高气温为 18-22 摄氏度（64-72 华氏度），更北的地区最高气温为 16-19 摄氏度（61-66 华氏度）。 英格兰和威尔士的周日和周一银行假日将继续变化无常，阵雨进一步增多，降雨持续时间更长，并且可能再次出现雷暴。 周一苏格兰可能会出现最潮湿的天气，而英格兰和威尔士预计将出现阳光和阵雨，然后更多降雨从西部进入。 英国南部地区也可能出现更强风，气温通常在 16 摄氏度至 23 摄氏度（61 至 73 华氏度）之间。 总体而言，八月底的银行假日周末看起来将比我们在这个创纪录的夏季大部分时间所经历的炎热和干燥的天气更加凉爽、多风和潮湿。 阵雨之间仍会有一些宜人的晴朗天气，东南部气温可能达到 20 多度。 然而，由于英国附近仍存在低压，目前几乎没有迹象表明天气会恢复长期炎热和稳定的状态。 九月初的前景表明天气状况将进一步变化，阳光和阵雨混合存在，气温普遍接近或略低于平均水平。 无论周末有何计划，您都可以通过查看 BBC 天气网站和应用程序了解最新天气预报。

title.en: 'Mad honey' that can stop your heart is now being sold online worldwide
title.zh: 可以让你心跳停止的“疯狂蜂蜜”现在在全球范围内在线销售

summary.en: A few months ago, a friend of mine told me that his father-in-law had been rushed to the hospital after eating some wild honey brought back from the hills of Nepal.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A few months ago, a friend of mine told me that his father-in-law had been rushed to the hospital after eating some wild honey brought back from the hills of Nepal.

Within about 30 minutes, his heart rate had dropped dangerously low, and his blood pressure had collapsed. He recovered, but the episode was terrifying for the whole family.

As a chemical ecologist from Nepal, I knew immediately what had happened. My friend's father-in-law had eaten wild honey , known locally as "bhir mauri ko maha," from the Himalayan cliff bee .

These bees forage on rhododendron flowers that carry a natural toxin called grayanotoxin. As bees collect the nectar, the toxin ends up concentrated in the honey. This is what's now popularized worldwide as "mad honey."

Eat a teaspoonful, and you might feel pleasantly warm and slightly lightheaded. Eat more than a few tablespoons, and your heart rate can drop to life-threatening levels . The exact amount that causes harm varies by batch, season and location.

The Indigenous Gurung people of Nepal have built up knowledge of safe doses over generations. But that knowledge is being lost as wild Himalayan honey has begun to be sold on major international online platforms.

For over a decade, I have studied how insects and plants fight each other using chemistry. Plants make toxic compounds, insects figure out ways to store or use those toxins, and the whole arms race plays out over millions of years . This fascinating world of insects and plants usually stays far from human lives.

But mad honey is bringing toxic compounds into contact with humans, creating a public health problem.

When I investigated, I found that doctors were publishing individual case reports, but no one had looked at the bigger picture. That gap struck me. I wanted to find out more about where exactly these poisonings are happening, to whom and why.

I wanted to trace the whole chain, from the flower to the bee to the honey to the hospital. So I teamed up with two medical doctors who had published a case report of patients who had been poisoned.

The Himalayan cliff bee , Apis laboriosa, is the world's largest honeybee. It lives only in the high Himalayas, nesting and building enormous exposed combs on sheer cliff faces at altitudes of up to 13,000 feet (4,000 meters).

In spring, when rhododendron flowers are at their peak, the bees forage heavily on their blooms. The nectar contains grayanotoxin, a chemical the plant likely evolved to deter insects that steal nectar without pollinating the flower.

The bees collect the nectar anyway and concentrate it in their honey....
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 几个月前，我的一个朋友告诉我，他的岳父吃了一些从尼泊尔山上带回来的野蜂蜜，被紧急送往医院。 大约 30 分钟内，他的心率下降到危险的低水平，血压也急剧下降。他康复了，但这一事件对全家人来说都很可怕。 作为一名来自尼泊尔的化学生态学家，我立即知道发生了什么事。我朋友的岳父吃过野生蜂蜜，当地称为“bhir mauri ko maha”，来自喜马拉雅悬崖蜜蜂。 这些蜜蜂以杜鹃花为食，杜鹃花带有一种叫做灰木毒素的天然毒素。当蜜蜂采集花蜜时，毒素最终会浓缩在蜂蜜中。这就是现在在全世界流行的“疯狂蜂蜜”。 吃一茶匙，你可能会感到温暖宜人，并有点头晕。吃超过几汤匙，你的心率就会下降到危及生命的水平。造成伤害的确切数量因批次、季节和地点而异。 尼泊尔土著古隆人几代人以来积累了安全剂量的知识。但随着野生喜马拉雅蜂蜜开始在主要国际在线平台上销售，这种知识正在消失。 十多年来，我一直在研究昆虫和植物如何利用化学相互对抗。植物产生有毒化合物，昆虫找到储存或使用这些毒素的方法，整个军备竞赛持续了数百万年。这个迷人的昆虫和植物世界通常远离人类生活。 但疯狂的蜂蜜正在使有毒化合物与人类接触，造成公共健康问题。 当我调查时，我发现医生只是发表个别病例报告，但没有人看到大局。这个差距让我震惊。我想更多地了解这些中毒事件到底发生在哪里、发生在谁身上以及发生的原因。 我想追踪整个链条，从花到蜜蜂，再到蜂蜜，再到医院。因此，我与两位发表了中毒患者病例报告的医生合作。 喜马拉雅悬崖蜂（Apis Laboriosa）是世界上最大的蜜蜂。它只生活在喜马拉雅山高处，在海拔高达 13,000 英尺（4,000 米）的陡峭悬崖上筑巢并建造巨大的裸露蜂巢。 春天，杜鹃花开得最盛，蜜蜂大量采食杜鹃花的花朵。花蜜中含有灰霉毒素，这种化学物质很可能是植物进化出来的，用来阻止昆虫在不给花授粉的情况下窃取花蜜。 蜜蜂无论如何都会收集花蜜并将其浓缩在蜂蜜中......

title.en: 'Our parents were crossing the border an hour before the flood hit'
title.zh: “我们希望他们回家”：家人焦急等待尼泊尔洪水失踪亲人的消息

summary.en: Over 1,300 people are missing, including dozens of Americans and Canadians, following deadly flash floods and mudslides in Nepal. Nepali authorities report over 380 fatalities. Families are anxiously awaiting news of their loved ones, with some having last spoken to them just before the disaster.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔发生致命的洪水和泥石流后，有超过1300人失踪，其中包括数十名美国和加拿大人。尼泊尔当局报告称已有超过380人死亡。家属们焦急地等待亲人的消息，其中一些人在灾难发生前不久才与他们通过话。

body.en:
Hundreds of foreign nationals are desperately waiting to hear from loved ones thought to be caught in the deadly flash flood and mudslide along the Nepal-Tibet border.

Sisters Shreya and Ashna Ahuja are among those anxiously waiting for some news of their parents, Deepak and Madhu Ahuja, who had travelled from Texas to Mount Kailash on a group pilgrimage.

"It's only been one day, but it has felt like much longer," the sisters tell the BBC. "We just love them a lot and want them to come home." One of the siblings spoke to their parents just before the floods struck.

More than 1,300 people are missing, including tourists from the US, Australia, Canada, India, and the UK. Nepali authorities say more than 380 people have died.

About 90 US citizens may have been impacted by the floods, the State Department said on Thursday, confirming that three Americans had been rescued.

The Ahuja sisters have contacted the State Department and US embassies in Delhi, Nepal and China, but they say they have no concrete information on the whereabouts of their parents.

The region is a pilgrimage site for Hindus and Buddhists, and visited by tens of thousands of pilgrims each year.

Radhika Sharma's parents, Ramesh Sharma, 65 and Neelam Sharma, 64, two US citizens who live in New York City, were also travelling to Mount Kailash in the Kathmandu region when the disaster struck.

"I am just trying to find them, I don't have any answers," Radhika Sharma told the BBC. Sharma is typically in frequent contact with her parents, often texting multiple times during the day.

"The last we know is they were at the border at 8am, so about an hour before the floods," she said. "And we are hoping that they made it to the Tibet side."

Sharma, who has been in contact with the US embassies in Beijing and Kathmandu, said: "No one has any answers."

She has also connected with other Americans who are in a similar situation, to support one another and consolidate information.

At least 77 people caught in the disaster are part of a pilgrimage organised by the Isha Foundation, a non-profit group headquartered in India that also has a base in McMinnville, Tennessee.

Leslie Crespi, a community liaison for the Foundation, told the BBC that the group had been working on immigration paperwork in what was meant to be an earthquake-resistant building near the border when the water came through.

Prabhath Sajeepa, another US citizen who went missing after the flood hit, was one of the 77 people travelling with the Isha Foundation.

Sajeepa works for a software company in California, and has been involved with the Isha Foundation for a few years, according to his niece, who lives in Germany.

"It has been terrible. I hope he is somewhere safe," his niece, Kavya Koulagi Jayatheertha, told the...

body.en: As multidrug antibiotic resistance emerges as a potent public health challenge, medical science has renewed attention on the potential for bacteriophage therapy. Bacteriophages, or phages, are viruses that target, infect and replicate inside bacteria, destroying them in the process. To help maximize the success rate of this approach, researchers recently modeled the dynamics of bacteriophage therapy to explain particular therapies and optimize the composition of bacteriophage cocktails.

title.en: Evolution favors flatter paths when fitness outcomes are equal, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现，当健康结果相同时，进化有利于平坦的道路

summary.en: A surprising discovery by Technion researchers sheds new light on the dynamics of evolution. Published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, the study shows that when an organism has several evolutionary paths available with equal fitness, the path it follows...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A surprising discovery by Technion researchers sheds new light on the dynamics of evolution. Published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences , the study shows that when an organism has several evolutionary paths available with equal fitness, the path it follows is not necessarily chosen at random.

The research was led by Razi Fachar Eldeen of the Faculty of Mathematics and professor Naama Brenner of the Wolfson Faculty of Chemical Engineering, both of whom are members of the Technion's Network Biology Research Laboratory.

According to Brenner, "Evolution is commonly described as a process of climbing fitness peaks, in which organisms become better adapted to their environment and thus improve their chances of survival. However, organisms sometimes face multiple evolutionary trajectories that all yield the same level of fitness. This raises the question of how evolution selects among these paths of equivalent fitness."

The Technion researchers found that the choice is not random. Rather than wandering aimlessly, populations deterministically drift toward flatter regions of the evolutionary landscape, where an organism's traits are more robust to mutations and other perturbations. In other words, when fitness is equal, evolution tends to favor directions that confer greater robustness and tolerance to change, properties that themselves provide a survival advantage.

The findings suggest that biological robustness and resilience to disruption can emerge spontaneously through evolutionary dynamics, even in the absence of direct selection favoring these traits.

The study may have broad implications for understanding the evolution of complex biological systems. It could help explain patterns of biological variation observed in nature, deepen our understanding of the origins of robustness in living systems, and build conceptual bridges between evolutionary biology and fields such as deep learning, where neural networks likewise tend to converge on flat minima that promote better generalization.

Razi Fachareldeen et al, Evolution on degenerate fitness landscapes is not random: Curvature drives directional drift, Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (2026). DOI: 10.1073/pnas.2605142123

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 以色列理工学院研究人员的一项惊人发现为进化动力学提供了新的线索。这项发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上的研究表明，当一个有机体有几条同等适应性的进化路径时，它所遵循的路径不一定是随机选择的。 这项研究由数学学院的 Razi Fachar Eldeen 和沃尔夫森化学工程学院的 Naama Brenner 教授领导，他们都是以色列理工学院网络生物学研究实验室的成员。 布伦纳表示，“进化通常被描述为攀登适应度峰值的过程，在这个过程中，生物体变得更好地适应环境，从而提高了生存机会。然而，生物体有时会面临多种进化轨迹，而这些轨迹都产生相同水平的适应度。这就提出了一个问题：进化如何在这些具有同等适应度的路径中进行选择。” 以色列理工学院的研究人员发现，这种选择并不是随机的。种群不会漫无目的地徘徊，而是确定性地向进化景观中更平坦的区域漂移，在这些区域中，有机体的特征对突变和其他扰动更加稳健。换句话说，当适应度相同时，进化往往会倾向于具有更大稳健性和对变化的容忍度的方向，这些特性本身就提供了生存优势。 研究结果表明，即使没有有利于这些特征的直接选择，生物的稳健性和抗破坏能力也可以通过进化动力学自发地出现。 这项研究可能对理解复杂生物系统的进化具有广泛的意义。它可以帮助解释在自然界中观察到的生物变异模式，加深我们对生命系统稳健性起源的理解，并在进化生物学和深度学习等领域之间建立概念桥梁，其中神经网络同样倾向于收敛于平坦最小值，从而促进更好的泛化。 Razi Fachareldeen 等人，退化适应度景观的进化不是随机的：曲率驱动定向漂移，《美国国家科学院院刊》（2026 年）。 DOI：10.1073/pnas.2605142123 英语硕士，自 2021 年起担任文案编辑，拥有高等教育和健康内容方面的经验。致力于值得信赖的科学新闻。完整档案 → 数学生物学学士学位，创意写作硕士学位。游历广泛，对科学和语言有独特的观点。完整档案 →

title.en: Clean-up of illegal waste supersite costs taxpayers £6m
title.zh: 清理非法垃圾超级站花费纳税人 600 万英镑

summary.en: The bill for clearing the dump in Oxfordshire has been covered by taxpayers.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The clear-up of one of England's largest illegal waste tips has been completed - landing taxpayers with a £6m bill.

The government has vowed to recoup the clearance costs for the Kidlington dump in Oxfordshire - and seven other sites - from the criminals responsible.

In 2025, around 22,000 tonnes of domestic and commercial rubbish was dumped at the spot, between the River Cherwell and the A34. It is one of nearly 30 so-called "supersites" first uncovered by a BBC investigation .

The government, which launched a crackdown on waste crime last week, said it would do more to force criminals to pay for clean-up operations by confiscating their money and assets.

But figures obtained by the BBC show that, in the past five years, the Environment Agency has so far managed to claw back just over £7m from waste criminals using Proceeds of Crime Act (Poca) confiscation orders.

At the same time, the agency says waste crime costs the economy £1bn a year. , external

Campaigners have labelled the amount taken from convicted criminals as "derisory" while the Country Land and Business Association (CLA), which represents rural landowners, asked: "Where is the deterrent?"

The amount paid by criminals so far was revealed by an Environmental Information Regulations (EIR) request to the Environment Agency by the BBC.

It shows there have been 66 confiscation orders between January 2021 and March 2026, totalling £7.3m.

Fourteen orders have yet to be fully paid, leaving around £1.4m still to be recovered.

The figures cover those larger illegal sites for which the Environment Agency is responsible, and do not include confiscation orders for smaller fly-tipping offences, which fall under the remit of local authorities.

Baroness Sheehan, who chairs the House of Lords environment and climate change committee, said the figures obtained by the BBC showed "consistent, decisive enforcement" was lacking.

"With clean-up costs at sites such as Kidlington far exceeding these sums, and enforcement still lagging, the taxpayer continues to foot the bill," the Liberal Dem peer said.

"The Environment Agency must do more to secure and enforce confiscation orders against those responsible, so criminals pay - not communities."

As well as the work at the Kidlington site, the Environment Agency has also stepped in to clear a supersite at Hoads Wood, near Ashford in Kent .

The cost of these two clearances alone has been budgeted at £20m by the Environment Agency - although the Kidlington project has come in under the original £7.3m contract.

In the Waste Crime Action Plan , external , launched under Keir Starmer's administration, the government said the Environment Agency would step in "on an exceptional basis to clear sites where that waste presents an untenable risk to the public...
body.zh: 英国最大的非法垃圾填埋场之一的清理工作已经完成，纳税人将收到 600 万英镑的账单。 政府誓言要向犯罪分子追偿牛津郡基德灵顿垃圾场以及其他七个垃圾场的清理费用。 2025 年，约 22,000 吨生活垃圾和商业垃圾被倾倒在查韦尔河和 A34 公路之间的地点。它是 BBC 调查首次发现的近 30 个所谓“超级网站”之一。 上周发起打击废物犯罪的政府表示，将采取更多措施，通过没收犯罪分子的金钱和资产来迫使犯罪分子支付清理费用。 但 BBC 获得的数据显示，在过去五年中，环境局迄今为止已利用《犯罪收益法》(Poca) 没收令，从废物犯罪分子手中追回了超过 700 万英镑。 与此同时，该机构表示，浪费犯罪每年给经济造成 10 亿英镑的损失。 , 外部 活动人士称，从已定罪罪犯身上收取的金额是“可笑的”，而代表农村土地所有者的乡村土地和商业协会（CLA）则问道：“威慑力在哪里？” 英国广播公司 (BBC) 向环境局提出环境信息条例 (EIR) 要求，披露了迄今为止犯罪分子支付的金额。 数据显示，2021 年 1 月至 2026 年 3 月期间共发出了 66 项没收令，总计 730 万英镑。 14 笔订单尚未全额支付，尚有约 140 万英镑有待收回。 这些数字涵盖了环境局负责的较大非法场地，不包括对小型非法倾倒垃圾行为的没收令，这些违法行为属于地方当局的职权范围。 上议院环境和气候变化委员会主席希恩男爵夫人表示，英国广播公司获得的数据显示，英国缺乏“一致、果断的执法”。 这位自由民主党同僚表示：“基德灵顿等地点的清理费用远远超过这些金额，而且执法仍然滞后，纳税人继续买单。” “环境局必须采取更多措施，确保并执行对责任人的没收令，这样犯罪分子才能付出代价，而不是社区。” 除了基德灵顿场地的工作外，环境局还介入清理肯特郡阿什福德附近霍兹伍德的超级场地。 仅这两次清理的费用就已被环境局预算为 2000 万英镑，尽管基德灵顿项目已纳入最初 730 万英镑的合同中。 在凯尔·斯塔默 (Keir Starmer) 政府领导下启动的《外部废物犯罪行动计划》中，政府表示，环境局将“在特殊情况下介入，清理那些废物对公众构成难以承受的风险的地点……”

reflection.en: This story draws attention to stewardship, provision, and the common good. 1 Peter 4:10 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with stewardship that serves neighbours, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到管家责任、供应与公共福祉。1 Peter 4:10提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以服事邻舍的好管家心态来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: BBC Inside Science
title.zh: BBC 科学内幕

summary.en: The proliferation of data centers, potentially numbering in the hundreds, raises questions about their varied and often unclear impacts, including carbon emissions, water usage, and power consumption. This report aims to clarify these issues with expert insights.
summary.zh: 数据中心正大量涌现，可能多达数百个。它们对碳排放、用水量和能源消耗等方面的各种影响，其真相往往难以辨别。本报道旨在通过专家见解来澄清这些问题。

body.en: Reports about the impacts of datacentres, including carbon emissions, water usage and power consumption, vary drastically and the truth can be hard to decipher. Deborah Andrews, Emeritus Professor at London South Bank University, joins us for some myth busting. Plus, science journalist Caroline Steel has been scouring the journals and brings us some of this week’s most exciting science news, including the failed attempts to save the Swift space telescope. Presenter: Tom Whipple Producers: Alex Mansfield, Katie Tomsett, Keiran Manetta-Jones Editor: Ilan Goodman Production Co-ordinator: Jana Bennett-Holesworth
body.zh: 关于数据中心的影响（包括碳排放、用水和电力消耗）的报告差异很大，真相可能很难解读。伦敦南岸大学名誉教授黛博拉·安德鲁斯 (Deborah Andrews) 与我们一起打破神话。此外，科学记者卡罗琳·斯蒂尔（Caroline Steel）一直在搜寻期刊，为我们带来了本周最令人兴奋的一些科学新闻，包括拯救斯威夫特太空望远镜的失败尝试。主持人：Tom Whipple 制片人：Alex Mansfield、Katie Tomsett、Keiran Manetta-Jones 编辑：Ilan Goodman 制作协调员：Jana Bennett-Holesworth

reflection.en: The rapid growth of data centers, as highlighted in this report, represents a surge in human knowledge and technological capability. Daniel 12:4 speaks of knowledge increasing and many running to and fro, a fitting image for our current era where understanding the complex consequences of such advancements, like those of data centers, becomes a pressing...
reflection.zh: 本报道中突出显示的数据中心快速增长，代表了人类知识和技术能力的激增。但以理书12:4预言“许多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长”，这恰当地描绘了我们这个时代，理解此类进步（如数据中心）的复杂后果，已成为一项紧迫的挑战。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: France relaxes strict cheese-making rules after prolonged drought
title.zh: 法国放松严格奶酪制作规定以应对长期干旱

summary.en: Makers of some of France's most famous cheeses are receiving waivers on where their herds graze due to a lack of grass caused by a prolonged drought. This temporary relaxation of rules allows farmers to use feed from outside their designated geographical zones.
summary.zh: 由于长期干旱导致牧草短缺，法国一些最著名奶酪的生产商获得了关于牧群放牧地点的豁免。这项暂时的规定放松允许农民使用来自其指定地理区域以外的饲料。

body.en:
France has temporarily relaxed rules for making some of its best-known cheeses after the summer drought drastically reduced the amount of grass available to feed milk herds.

Government decrees to grant dispensations to manufacturers of Abondance, Beaufort and Comté cheeses - which come from mountains in eastern France - appeared on Wednesday.

Several other cheeses are expected to receive similar waivers, allowing farmers to feed livestock with grass and hay brought in from outside their strict geographical zone.

These include Cantal, Bleu d'Auvergne, Fourme d'Ambert, Bleu du Vercors-Sassenage, Reblochon and the goats cheese Rocamadour.

The National Institute for Origin and Quality (INAO), which regulates France's labels of origin, has also approved temporary changes to the rules for other protected produce because of the effects of the summer heat.

Products that will benefit include some types of Calvados and cider from Normandy, Crémant d'Alsace fizzy wine, lamb from Poitou-Charentes, and Reine-Claude plums.

Certificates of origin allow farmers to sell at a premium, but they come with strict regulations governing the location and method of production.

The aim is to preserve the unique identity of cheeses, wines and other foodstuffs, supposedly linked to their particular terroir - a French concept that links locality and tradition.

Because of a 2026 drought - which the INAO now describes as "historic" - farmers are being allowed to bend the rules for a short period.

Makers of Abondance cheese in the Alps, for example, will be authorised to reduce the amount of pastured grass in their animals' diet from 50% to 15%. They will be entitled to import forage from outside their zone, and use some supplements.

Makers of Comté cheese in the Jura mountains will be able to replace the local green maize they usually give to their cattle with maize from elsewhere.

The derogations are allowed in French and European law for periods of exceptional weather. Similar measures came in after the dry summer of 2022.

It will be interesting to see if the changes lead to any detectable change in the taste or quality of the cheeses - or to the quantity produced and how it is priced.

Longer term, the measures raise questions over the viability of the existing labels of origin in France and elsewhere.

If changing climate means that certain foodstuffs can no longer be produced in their traditional localities, then the idea of terroir will be stretched to its limits.
body.zh: 夏季干旱大幅减少了可用于喂养奶牛群的草量，法国暂时放宽了制作一些最著名奶酪的规定。 周三，政府颁布了法令，向来自法国东部山区的 Abondance、Beaufort 和 Comté 奶酪制造商提供特许。 其他几种奶酪预计也将获得类似的豁免，允许农民用从其严格地理区域之外引进的草和干草喂养牲畜。 其中包括 Cantal、Bleu d'Auvergne、Fourme d'Ambert、Bleu du Vercors-Sassenage、Reblochon 和 Rocamadour 山羊奶酪。 由于夏季炎热的影响，负责监管法国原产地标签的国家原产地和质量研究所 (INAO) 也批准对其他受保护产品的规则进行临时修改。 受益的产品包括来自诺曼底的某些类型的卡尔瓦多斯苹果酒和苹果酒、阿尔萨斯起泡酒、来自普瓦图-夏朗德的羊肉以及雷讷-克洛德李子。 原产地证书允许农民以溢价出售，但它们对生产地点和方法有严格的规定。 其目的是保留奶酪、葡萄酒和其他食品的独特特性，据称这些特性与其特定的风土条件有关——这是一个将地方和传统联系起来的法国概念。 由于 2026 年发生的干旱（INAO 现在将其称为“历史性的”），农民被允许在短时间内改变规则。 例如，阿尔卑斯山的 Abondance 奶酪制造商将被授权将其动物饮食中的牧草含量从 50% 减少到 15%。他们将有权从其区域外进口饲料，并使用一些补充剂。 汝拉山区的孔泰奶酪制造商将能够用其他地方的玉米代替他们通常给牛群喂的当地绿色玉米。 法国和欧洲法律允许在特殊天气期间进行减损。 2022 年干燥的夏季之后也采取了类似的措施。 看看这些变化是否会导致奶酪的味道或质量发生任何可检测到的变化，或者产量和定价的变化，将会很有趣。 从长远来看，这些措施引发了人们对法国和其他地方现有原产地标签的可行性的质疑。 如果气候变化意味着某些食品不能再在其传统产地生产，那么风土的概念将延伸至其极限。

reflection.en: The prolonged drought in France has forced a temporary change in the strict rules governing cheese production, allowing farmers to feed their herds with hay brought from outside their traditional grazing areas. This situation highlights the vulnerability of even well-established traditions to the harsh realities of nature, reminding us that human endeavors...
reflection.zh: 法国的长期干旱迫使奶酪生产的严格规定暂时放松，允许农民使用来自传统放牧区以外的干草喂养他们的牛群。这种情况凸显了即使是根深蒂固的传统也容易受到严酷自然现实的影响，提醒我们人类的努力常常受到我们无法控制的力量的制约。...

verse.textEn: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines... yet I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verse.textZh: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果……然而，我要因雅伟欢欣。

title.en: West Point’s only climate scientist fired after continuing to teach human causes of climate change
title.zh: 西点军校唯一的气候科学家因继续教授人类导致气候变化而被解雇

summary.en: The sole climate scientist at West Point, Dr. Adam Kalkstein, was fired after allegedly refusing an order to stop teaching about the human causes of the climate emergency. A lawsuit claims his termination followed a disagreement with the academy's academic board dean.
summary.zh: 西点军校唯一的气候科学家亚当·卡尔克斯坦博士，在据称拒绝停止教授气候变化的人为原因后被解雇。一项诉讼声称，他的解雇是在与学院学术委员会院长发生分歧之后发生的。

body.en: Adam Kalkstein compared administration’s order to trying to teach the law without mentioning the constitution The only climate scientist teaching at West Point, the US army’s military academy, was fired after he resisted an order to stop teaching about the human causes of the climate emergency, a lawsuit claims. Dr Adam Kalkstein, a civilian professor of geography at the New York institution, was terminated after the spring semester this year, six months after a testy meeting with Brig Gen Shane Reeves, then dean of West Point’s academic board, the court filing said. Continue reading...
body.zh: 亚当·卡尔克斯坦将政府的命令比作“试图教授法律”，却没有提到“宪法”。诉讼称，美国陆军军事学院西点军校唯一任教的气候科学家因拒绝停止教授有关气候紧急情况的人为原因的命令而被解雇。法庭文件称，纽约大学地理学教授亚当·卡尔克斯坦博士在今年春季学期结束后被解雇，六个月前，他与时任西点军校学术委员会主任沙恩·里夫斯准将进行了一次激烈的会面。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Dr. Adam Kalkstein's dismissal for teaching established climate science raises questions about academic freedom and the suppression of truth. When faced with directives that contradict observable reality and scientific consensus, the courage to uphold truth, even at personal cost, echoes the apostles' declaration: 'We must obey God rather than human...
reflection.zh: 亚当·卡尔克斯坦博士因教授既定的气候科学而被解雇，这引发了关于学术自由和真相被压制的疑问。当面临与可观察到的现实和科学共识相悖的指令时，即使付出个人代价也要坚持真理的勇气，呼应了使徒的宣告：“我们必须服从雅伟，而不是人。”这种情况促使我们思考，当机构的要求与基本真理发生冲突时，我们最终的忠诚何在。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Everyone hates datacentres. Do we really need them? - video
title.zh: 每个人都讨厌数据中心。我们真的需要它们吗？- 视频

summary.en: AI companies have promised us world-shifting technology. But there’s a cost: loud, unsightly datacentres that drain environmental resources. As the government pushes their rapid growth, can local communities do anything to push back? Madeleine Finlay speaks to the Guardian’s global technology reporter Aisha Down about...
summary.zh: 人工智能公司向我们承诺了能够改变世界的科技。但其代价是：嘈杂、难看的数据中心耗尽环境资源。随着政府推动其快速增长，当地社区能做些什么来反击呢？玛德琳·芬利与《卫报》全球科技记者艾莎·唐（Aisha Down）谈论了英国及世界各地对数据中心的反对声音。

body.en: AI companies have promised us world-shifting technology. But there’s a cost: loud, unsightly datacentres that drain environmental resources. As the government pushes their rapid growth, can local communities do anything to push back? Madeleine Finlay speaks to the Guardian’s global technology reporter Aisha Down about the backlash to datacentres across the UK and around the world
body.zh: 人工智能公司向我们承诺提供改变世界的技术。但这是有代价的：噪音大、难看的数据中心会耗尽环境资源。当政府推动其快速增长时，当地社区可以采取措施来阻止吗？马德琳·芬利 (Madeleine Finlay) 向《卫报》全球科技记者 Aisha Down 讲述了英国和世界各地对数据中心的强烈反对

reflection.en: The relentless drive for ever-more powerful AI, housed in sprawling datacenters, echoes the ancient story of Babel. Humanity's ambition to reach the heavens through technological might, without regard for its impact on the earth or its inhabitants, raises questions about our ultimate goals and wisdom. Are we building towers that will ultimately divide us,...
reflection.zh: 对日益强大的人工智能的不懈追求，以及容纳它们的庞大数据中心，让人想起古代巴别塔的故事。人类试图通过技术力量触及天堂，却不顾其对地球及其居民的影响，这引发了对我们终极目标和智慧的疑问。我们是在建造最终将分裂我们的高塔，还是在奠定服务于万物的根基？

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: AI searched 100 million possibilities and found a cheaper way to 3D-print a NASA rocket alloy
title.zh: 人工智能搜索了1亿种可能性，找到了3D打印NASA火箭合金的更便宜方法

summary.en: Researchers utilized AI to explore over 100 million potential settings for 3D printing a high-performance NASA alloy. Within just 40 experiments, the system identified six successful configurations, including one that operated at a record low of 500 watts, potentially enabling wider use of the alloy.
summary.zh: 研究人员利用人工智能搜索了超过1亿种3D打印高性能NASA合金的可能设置。仅进行了40次实验，该系统就确定了六种成功的配置，其中包括一种以创纪录的500瓦低功率运行的配置，这可能使该合金得到更广泛的应用。

body.en:
Washington State University researchers have used artificial intelligence to identify a faster and less costly way to 3D print a high-performance metal alloy, avoiding the need to manually test more than 100 million possible printing configurations.

The advance could eventually make the alloy, which is widely used in aerospace applications and may have uses in other industries, printable on more common commercial equipment. The AI strategy developed by the team could also be useful for other scientific problems involving enormous numbers of possible experiments, including drug discovery.

Researchers from WSU's School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science and the School of Mechanical and Materials Engineering published the work in the Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence . The project also received the Innovative Deployed Application Award at the organization's annual conference.

"Ninety percent of commercial printers cannot print this metal alloy, so given that we were able to find these feasible process parameters, it allows us to use those commercial printers, and we are essentially democratizing the printing of this alloy," said Jana Doppa, Huie-Rogers Endowed Chair Professor of Computer Science and Berry Distinguished Professor in Engineering who led the research.

The material, GRCop-42, is an alloy made from copper, chromium, and niobium. NASA developed it for demanding environments where both heat resistance and efficient heat transfer are essential.

Because GRCop-42 has high thermal conductivity while maintaining its strength at extreme temperatures, it is used in aerospace systems, including liquid rocket engine combustion chambers. Despite its desirable properties and broader potential, however, the alloy is difficult and costly to 3D print because the process typically requires substantial laser power and energy.

Previous attempts to print GRCop-42 using the lower wattages available on more common commercial machines had not succeeded. Testing possible printing settings one by one is also impractical. Each attempt consumes expensive material, requires specialized equipment, and takes considerable human effort. A single print can cost hundreds of dollars, and thoroughly analyzing the finished sample can require several days.

"Sometimes they printed a certain configuration, and the product just melted," said Azza Fadhel, first author of the paper and a PhD student in computer science. "It wasn't really printable, and even with time and money, they wouldn't be able to try all 100 million options. What we were doing in our collaboration is to apply the AI so that we efficiently choose candidates from this very large search space."

The researchers started with data from 37 printing configurations that...
body.zh: 华盛顿州立大学的研究人员利用人工智能找到了一种更快、成本更低的 3D 打印高性能金属合金的方法，从而无需手动测试超过 1 亿种可能的打印配置。 这一进展最终可能使这种广泛用于航空航天应用并可能用于其他行业的合金可以在更常见的商业设备上打印。该团队开发的人工智能策略也可用于解决涉及大量可能实验的其他科学问题，包括药物发现。 来自华盛顿州立大学电气工程与计算机科学学院以及机械与材料工程学院的研究人员在 AAAI 人工智能会议论文集上发表了这项工作。该项目还在该组织的年会上获得了创新部署应用程序奖。 “百分之九十的商业打印机无法打印这种金属合金，因此，鉴于我们能够找到这些可行的工艺参数，它允许我们使用这些商业打印机，并且我们基本上使这种合金的打印民主化，”领导这项研究的计算机科学教授兼贝里杰出工程教授 Jana Doppa 说。 该材料 GRCop-42 是一种由铜、铬和铌制成的合金。 NASA 为耐热性和高效传热都至关重要的苛刻环境开发了它。 由于 GRCop-42 具有高导热性，同时在极端温度下仍保持强度，因此用于航空航天系统，包括液体火箭发动机燃烧室。然而，尽管该合金具有理想的特性和更广泛的潜力，但它的 3D 打印难度很大且成本高昂，因为该过程通常需要大量的激光功率和能量。 之前尝试使用更常见的商用机器上可用的较低瓦数打印 GRCop-42 并未成功。一项一项地测试可能的打印设置也是不切实际的。每次尝试都消耗昂贵的材料，需要专门的设备，并且需要大量的人力。一次打印可能花费数百美元，彻底分析完成的样本可能需要几天的时间。 “有时他们打印出某种配置，然后产品就融化了，”该论文的第一作者、计算机科学博士生 Azza Fadhel 说。 “它并不是真正可打印的，即使有时间和金钱，他们也无法尝试所有 1 亿个选项。我们在合作中所做的是应用人工智能，以便我们从这个非常大的搜索空间中有效地选择候选人。” 研究人员从 37 种打印配置的数据开始，这些数据......

While this innovation promises efficiency and cost savings, it also calls us to consider the wisdom and ethical frameworks guiding such powerful tools. May we pursue knowledge with humility and a deep...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展，正如这项研究所示，反映了知识和技术能力加速的更广泛趋势。虽然这项创新有望提高效率和节省成本，但它也促使我们思考指导这些强大工具的智慧和伦理框架。愿我们以谦卑和对其潜在影响的深刻尊重来追求知识。

title.en: “I jumped from my chair” – Astronomers spot Betelgeuse’s hidden companion
title.zh: “我从椅子上跳了起来”——天文学家发现参宿四隐藏的伴星

summary.en: Astronomers have captured their clearest image yet of Betelgeuse’s long-suspected companion, potentially ending a search that lasted about 100 years. The surprisingly massive hidden star could help explain Betelgeuse’s changing brightness and may influence its future supernova.
summary.zh: 天文学家们捕捉到了迄今为止最清晰的、关于人们长期以来猜测的参宿四伴星的图像，这可能结束了长达约100年的搜寻。这颗出人意料地巨大的隐藏恒星可能有助于解释参宿四亮度的变化，并可能影响其未来的超新星爆发。

body.en:
Astronomers now have their strongest evidence yet that Betelgeuse, one of the best-known stars in the night sky, has a stellar companion. A team led by French astronomer Miguel Montargès used the European Southern Observatory's Very Large Telescope (ESO's VLT) to capture the clearest image so far of what is believed to be Betelgeuse B, a star orbiting the famous red supergiant.

"We have shown that Betelgeuse is not single, it is accompanied by a faint stellar companion," says Montargès, astronomer at the Observatoire de Paris -- PSL, France, and lead author of the study published today in Astronomy & Astrophysics.

Betelgeuse -- a reddish star in the Orion constellation that is easily visible with the naked eye and is known to change in brightness -- has been watched by people for thousands of years. Even after centuries of scientific observation, however, the star continues to produce surprises.

"I jumped from my chair when I saw the processed images," recalls Montargès.

The possibility that Betelgeuse has a companion was first raised roughly a century ago as a potential explanation for some of its changes in brightness. Despite decades of observations, astronomers had been unable to clearly detect such a star.

That changed after Two studies published in 2024 made strong predictions about where the suspected companion should be. The studies indicated that Betelgeuse B would reach its greatest apparent separation from Betelgeuse in December 2024, giving astronomers their best opportunity to see it.

Montargès and his colleagues observed Betelgeuse with ESO's VLT that December. They then spent several months carefully processing and analyzing the observations.

"Honestly, I thought we did not have the sensitivity to detect Betelgeuse B as it was predicted," explains Montargès. "Because it is more massive than predicted, we see it!"

Scientists had initially estimated that the companion would have roughly the same mass as the Sun. The new observations instead suggest that Betelgeuse B is considerably larger, with about two to three times the Sun's mass.

"The fact that we can still discover a nearby companion, more massive and brighter than the Sun, around such a well-studied star is remarkable," says Montargès. "These are among the best moments in science: seeing something new, unexpected."

The researchers directly imaged Betelgeuse B, meaning they detected light coming from the companion itself. They accomplished this using the SPHERE instrument on ESO's VLT in Chile's Atacama Desert.

Previous observations had already provided clues that the companion existed, including a possible direct detection made with the Gemini North Telescope in Hawaiʻi, USA. The latest VLT observations, however, provide...
body.zh: 天文学家现在拥有迄今为止最有力的证据，证明夜空中最著名的恒星之一参宿四有一颗伴星。由法国天文学家 Miguel Montargès 领导的团队使用欧洲南方天文台的甚大望远镜（ESO 的 VLT）捕捉到了迄今为​​止最清晰的图像，据信是参宿四 B，这是一颗围绕着著名的红超巨星运行的恒星。 法国巴黎天文台的天文学家、今天发表在《天文学与天体物理学》杂志上的这项研究的主要作者蒙塔格斯说：“我们已经证明参宿四不是单一的，它还伴随着一颗微弱的恒星伴星。” 参宿四是猎户座中一颗微红色的恒星，肉眼很容易看到，并且亮度会发生变化，数千年来一直被人们所关注。然而，即使经过几个世纪的科学观察，这颗恒星仍然继续带来惊喜。 “当我看到处理后的图像时，我从椅子上跳了起来，”蒙塔格斯回忆道。 大约一个世纪前，参宿四有一个伴星的可能性首次被提出，作为其亮度变化的潜在解释。尽管进行了数十年的观测，天文学家仍无法清楚地探测到这样一颗恒星。 2024 年发表的两项研究对疑似同伴应该在哪里做出了强有力的预测后，情况发生了变化。研究表明，参宿四 B 将于 2024 年 12 月达到与参宿四的最大明显分离，这为天文学家提供了观测它的最佳机会。 那年 12 月，蒙塔格斯和他的同事用 ESO 的 VLT 观测了参宿四。然后他们花了几个月的时间仔细处理和分析观察结果。 “老实说，我认为我们没有像预测的那样具有检测参宿四 B 的灵敏度，”蒙塔吉斯解释道。 “因为它比预计的要大，所以我们看到了！” 科学家最初估计该伴星的质量与太阳大致相同。相反，新的观测表明参宿四 B 的质量要大得多，大约是太阳质量的两到三倍。 蒙塔格斯说：“我们仍然可以在这样一颗经过充分研究的恒星周围发现一个比太阳更大、更亮的伴星，这一事实是值得注意的。” “这是科学界最美好的时刻之一：看到一些新的、意想不到的东西。” 研究人员直接对参宿四 B 进行了成像，这意味着他们检测到了来自参宿四本身的光。他们使用位于智利阿塔卡马沙漠的 ESO VLT 上的 SPHERE 仪器完成了这一任务。 之前的观测已经提供了该伴星存在的线索，包括美国夏威夷双子座北望远镜可能进行的直接探测。然而，最新的 VLT 观测结果提供了……

This discovery of a hidden star near Betelgeuse, after a century of searching, reminds us that even familiar celestial bodies hold profound mysteries. It invites awe and contemplation of the intricate design woven into the fabric...
