title.en: Your dislike of eating bugs may be 9,000 years old
title.zh: 您对吃虫子的厌恶可能已有9000年的历史

summary.en: Ancient teeth and human DNA are revealing a surprising history of insect eating. Modern humans in northern Eurasia appear to have eaten insects only occasionally, while Neanderthals may have consumed them much more regularly. Populations near the tropics also retained genes that...
summary.zh: 古代牙齿和人类DNA揭示了令人惊讶的昆虫食用历史。北欧亚的现代人类似乎只偶尔食用昆虫，而尼安德特人可能食用得更规律。靠近热带地区的人群也保留了基因，这些基因...

body.en:
As the global population grows and climate change places increasing pressure on food systems, researchers and policymakers are looking more closely at alternative sources of nutrition. Insects are one possible option. A total of 1,611 insect species are classified as edible, and organizations including the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) have highlighted insects as a potentially sustainable food source.

Even so, many Western societies remain strongly resistant to entomophagy, or eating insects, despite the fact that hundreds of millions of people around the world already include insects in their diets. Culture may help explain that reluctance, but scientists have not known how far back it goes or what other forces may have shaped it.

Researchers from the Institute of Evolutionary Biology (IBE), a joint center of the Spanish National Research Council (CSIC) and Pompeu Fabra University (UPF), have now used genomic evidence to reconstruct patterns of insect consumption stretching back thousands of years. Their findings, published in Science Advances , indicate that eating insects was probably occasional and accidental in Europe, Central and East Asia, while it appears to have been more common in tropical regions and among Neanderthals. The work offers new insights into human evolution, ecology, and modern attitudes toward insect-based foods.

To search for direct signs of insect consumption, the IBE researchers examined 745 samples of dental calculus (tartar) from anatomically modern humans dating back as far as 33,000 years. Dental tartar can trap and preserve DNA from species that were regularly eaten, providing researchers with a record of ancient diets.

The results suggest that modern humans living in northern Eurasia did not regularly eat insects. The team also examined genes involved in breaking down chitin, a major component of insect exoskeletons. Among North Eurasian populations, chitinase genes contain mutations associated with a reduced ability to digest insect exoskeletons. That genetic pattern has persisted for roughly 9,000 years, dating back to the rise of agriculture.

"The scarce presence of insects in the diet of northern Eurasians suggests that the absence of entomophagy is not solely due to recent cultural factors, but also to a long ecological and evolutionary history," says Pablo Librado, principal investigator at the IBE who led the study.

The picture was different for Neanderthals. Although they lived in many of the same environments as anatomically modern humans, their dental calculus contained considerably more insect DNA.

The amount detected in Neanderthal samples was similar to levels found in western chimpanzees, which use insects to supplement their diets on the savanna, particularly...
body.zh: 随着全球人口增长和气候变化给粮食系统带来越来越大的压力，研究人员和政策制定者正在更加密切地寻找替代营养来源。昆虫是一种可能的选择。共有 1,611 种昆虫被列为可食用昆虫，包括联合国粮食及农业组织 (FAO) 在内的组织都强调昆虫是潜在的可持续食物来源。 即便如此，许多西方社会仍然强烈抵制食虫行为，尽管世界各地数亿人已经将昆虫纳入他们的饮食中。文化可能有助于解释这种不情愿，但科学家们还不知道它可以追溯到多久以前，也不知道是什么其他力量可能塑造了它。 西班牙国家研究委员会 (CSIC) 和庞培法布拉大学 (UPF) 联合中心进化生物学研究所 (IBE) 的研究人员现在利用基因组证据重建了数千年前的昆虫消费模式。他们发表在《科学进展》上的研究结果表明，在欧洲、中亚和东亚，吃昆虫可能是偶然和偶然的，而在热带地区和尼安德特人中，吃昆虫似乎更为常见。这项工作为人类进化、生态学和现代人对昆虫食品的态度提供了新的见解。 为了寻找昆虫食用的直接迹象，IBE 研究人员检查了 745 份来自解剖学上现代人类的牙结石（牙垢）样本，其历史可追溯到 33,000 年前。牙垢可以捕获并保存经常食用的物种的 DNA，为研究人员提供古代饮食记录。 结果表明，生活在欧亚大陆北部的现代人类并不经常吃昆虫。研究小组还检查了参与分解甲壳素（昆虫外骨骼的主要成分）的基因。在北欧亚种群中，几丁质酶基因含有与消化昆虫外骨骼能力降低相关的突变。这种遗传模式已经持续了大约 9000 年，可以追溯到农业兴起时。 领导这项研究的 IBE 首席研究员巴勃罗·利布拉多 (Pablo Librado) 表示：“欧亚大陆北部人的饮食中昆虫很少，这表明食虫行为的缺失不仅是由于最近的文化因素，而且还与悠久的生态和进化历史有关。” 对于尼安德特人来说，情况有所不同。尽管他们生活在许多与现代人类相同的环境中，但他们的牙结石含有更多的昆虫 DNA。 在尼安德特人样本中检测到的含量与在西方黑猩猩中发现的含量相似，西方黑猩猩在稀树草原上使用昆虫来补充饮食，特别是......

It reminds us that wisdom and knowledge about sustenance can be found by observing creation, as Job noted, 'But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the...

title.en: Near total lunar eclipse will be seen from North and South America Thursday night
title.zh: 周四晚间北美和南美将可见近乎全食的月食

summary.zh: 由于大气散射阳光，地球的阴影将呈现出红色的“血月”。周四晚间，北美和南美大部分地区将可见近乎全食的月食，预计数百万人将目睹这一天象奇观。

body.en: Earth’s shadow will appear to be a reddish ‘blood moon’ due to the way sunlight is scattered by the atmosphere A near total lunar eclipse will be visible across large swathes of North and South America on Thursday night with millions of people expected to be able to see one of nature’s marvels. Lunar eclipses occur when Earth moves between the sun and the moon and its shadow is cast on to the lunar surface. In Thursday night’s event 96% of the moon will be darkened by the Earth’s shadow at its peak moment. Continue reading...

title.en: A mysterious cosmic hum may come from 13-billion-year-old dark stars
title.zh: 神秘的宇宙嗡嗡声可能来自130亿年前的暗星

summary.en: A faint background of extremely low-frequency gravitational waves, detected through pulsar networks, may hold clues to events over 13 billion years ago, including the formation of the universe's first supermassive black holes. Researchers are investigating if these early black holes could contribute significantly to...
summary.zh: 通过脉冲星网络探测到的极低频引力波的微弱背景，可能包含130多亿年前事件的线索，包括宇宙最早的超大质量黑洞的出现。研究人员正在调查这些早期黑洞是否可能对当前测量的引力波背景做出重大贡献。

body.en:
A faint background of extremely low frequency gravitational waves detected through networks of pulsars could contain clues to events that unfolded more than 13 billion years ago, including the emergence of some of the Universe's earliest supermassive black holes.

In a study published as a Letter in Physical Review D , Colgate University researchers Sohan Ghodla and Cosmin Ilie examined whether supermassive black holes that originated in the early Universe could eventually produce a significant share of the gravitational wave background now being measured by Pulsar Timing Arrays, or PTAs.

The findings connect two areas of astronomy that may at first seem far apart. One involves observations of surprisingly massive black holes that already existed when the Universe was young. The other involves gravitational waves generated billions of years later by pairs of supermassive black holes spiraling toward one another.

The researchers found that one possible class of early black hole seeds, remnants left behind by supermassive Dark Stars, could potentially provide a dominant contribution to the PTA signal.

"Pulsar timing arrays are usually thought of as probes of supermassive black-hole binaries in the relatively recent Universe," said Ilie. "What our work shows is that the signal may also contain information about how the ancestors of those black holes formed at cosmic dawn. In that sense, gravitational waves observed today could provide a new window onto the birth of the first supermassive black holes."

Pulsar Timing Arrays rely on rapidly spinning neutron stars known as pulsars, which act as extraordinarily precise clocks in space. When gravitational waves pass through the cosmos, they cause tiny changes in the timing of the radio pulses that eventually arrive at Earth. By tracking many pulsars over long periods, international research teams have found evidence for a stochastic gravitational wave background at nanohertz frequencies.

The most widely accepted astrophysical explanation for this background is a population of supermassive black hole binaries gradually spiraling inward. Systems whose black holes have a combined mass greater than roughly a billion Suns make especially important contributions at the frequencies detected by PTAs.

But explaining those enormous black holes raises a deeper question. Astronomers still want to know how their original seeds formed. Observatories including the James Webb Space Telescope and Chandra have discovered massive black holes at unexpectedly early stages of cosmic history, increasing interest in formation mechanisms capable of producing large black hole seeds very quickly.

Ghodla and Ilie investigated whether the descendants of such ancient seeds could persist through cosmic time, grow alongside their...
body.zh: 通过脉冲星网络检测到的极低频引力波的微弱背景可能包含超过 130 亿年前发生的事件的线索，包括宇宙中一些最早的超大质量黑洞的出现。 在《物理评论 D》上发表的一项研究中，科尔盖特大学研究人员 Sohan Ghodla 和 Cosmin Ilie 研究了起源于早期宇宙的超大质量黑洞最终是否会产生目前由脉冲星定时阵列（PTA）测量的引力波背景的很大一部分。 这些发现将乍一看似乎相距甚远的两个天文学领域联系在一起。其中一项涉及对宇宙年轻时就已经存在的巨大黑洞的观测。另一种涉及数十亿年后由成对的超大质量黑洞相互螺旋运动产生的引力波。 研究人员发现，一类可能的早期黑洞种子，即超大质量暗星留下的残余物，可能对 PTA 信号产生主要贡献。 “脉冲星计时阵列通常被认为是相对较新的宇宙中超大质量黑洞双星的探测器，”伊利说。 “我们的工作表明，该信号还可能包含有关这些黑洞的祖先如何在宇宙黎明时形成的信息。从这个意义上说，今天观测到的引力波可以为了解第一个超大质量黑洞的诞生提供一个新的窗口。” 脉冲星计时阵列依赖于快速旋转的中子星（称为脉冲星），脉冲星在太空中充当极其精确的时钟。当引力波穿过宇宙时，它们会导致最终到达地球的无线电脉冲的时间发生微小变化。通过长期跟踪许多脉冲星，国际研究小组发现了纳赫频率随机引力波背景的证据。 对于这种背景，最广泛接受的天体物理学解释是一群超大质量黑洞双星逐渐向内盘旋。黑洞总质量超过大约 10 亿个太阳的系统在 PTA 检测到的频率上做出了特别重要的贡献。 但解释这些巨大的黑洞引发了一个更深层次的问题。天文学家仍然想知道它们最初的种子是如何形成的。包括詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜和钱德拉在内的天文台在宇宙历史的早期阶段意外地发现了巨大的黑洞，这增加了人们对能够快速产生大型黑洞种子的形成机制的兴趣。 戈德拉和伊利研究了这种古老种子的后代是否能够在宇宙时间中持续存在，与它们一起生长……

reflection.en: The vastness of the cosmos and the faint whispers of gravitational waves reaching us across billions of years invite awe. This scientific endeavor to understand the universe's origins, from hypothetical Dark Stars to the first black holes, echoes the ancient wisdom that creation itself speaks of its Maker's power and design. As we probe these cosmic...
reflection.zh: 宇宙的浩瀚以及跨越数十亿年传来的微弱引力波，引人深思。这项旨在理解宇宙起源的科学探索，从假想的暗星到最早的黑洞，呼应了古老的智慧——创造本身就诉说着造物主的权能与设计。当我们探究这些宇宙奥秘时，我们被提醒，雅伟的手在万有之中，无论可见或不可见。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Black Box: The Chatbots: a new series from The Guardian Investigates – trailer
title.zh: 黑匣子：聊天机器人：卫报调查新系列——预告片

summary.en: People are becoming convinced AI chatbots have helped them make scientific breakthroughs, cure diseases or invent new technologies. What does this reveal about a technology used by more than a billion people? A new series from The Guardian Investigates, coming soon.
summary.zh: 人们越来越相信人工智能聊天机器人帮助他们取得了科学突破、治愈了疾病或发明了新技术。这揭示了这项被超过十亿人使用的技术是怎样的？《卫报》调查新系列即将推出。

body.en: People are becoming convinced AI chatbots have helped them make scientific breakthroughs, cure diseases or invent new technologies. What does this reveal about a technology used by more than a billion people? A new series from The Guardian Investigates, coming soon
body.zh: 人们越来越相信人工智能聊天机器人已经帮助他们取得了科学突破、治愈疾病或发明新技术。对于超过十亿人使用的技术，这揭示了什么？ 《卫报调查》的新系列即将推出

reflection.en: The rapid advancement and widespread adoption of AI chatbots, as suggested by this news, echo the ancient prophecy of knowledge increasing in the end times. As we marvel at these new tools, we are reminded of the accelerating pace of human discovery and the profound implications for our world.
reflection.zh: 正如这则新闻所暗示的，人工智能聊天机器人的快速发展和广泛应用，呼应了古代关于知识增长的预言。当我们惊叹于这些新工具时，我们被提醒人类发现的步伐正在加快，以及这对我们的世界产生的深远影响。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Scientists switch on a strange new form of magnetism in an ultrathin material
title.zh: 科学家在超薄材料中开启一种奇特的磁性新形式

summary.en: Scientists have discovered a novel way to potentially activate an unusual type of magnetism in ruthenium dioxide, a material typically considered nonmagnetic. When this material was fashioned into an ultrathin film, just a few atomic layers thick, and subjected to strain, its electrons exhibited patterns indicative of...
summary.zh: 科学家们发现了一种潜在的、激活二氧化钌中一种不寻常磁性的新颖方法，而二氧化钌通常被认为是非磁性的。当这种材料被制成仅有几个原子层厚的超薄薄膜并承受应变时，其电子表现出与altermagnetism一致的模式，这是一种最近提出的磁态，在先进电子学中具有潜在应用。

body.en: Scientists have found a surprising way to potentially switch on an unusual form of magnetism in ruthenium dioxide, a material that normally appears nonmagnetic. When the material was made into an ultrathin film only a few atomic layers thick and placed under strain, its electrons developed patterns consistent with altermagnetism, a recently proposed magnetic state with promising uses in advanced electronics.
body.zh: 科学家们发现了一种令人惊讶的方法，可以在二氧化钌中开启一种不寻常的磁性，这种材料通常看起来是非磁性的。当这种材料被制成只有几个原子层厚的超薄膜并置于应变下时，其电子会形成与交变磁性一致的图案，这是最近提出的一种磁性状态，在先进电子学中具有广阔的应用前景。

reflection.en: The intricate dance of electrons within an ultrathin film, revealing a new form of magnetism, speaks to the profound order Yahweh has woven into the fabric of creation. Job reminds us that even the natural world, from the smallest material to the grandest celestial body, testifies to His wisdom and power. May we approach such discoveries with humility and...
reflection.zh: 电子在超薄薄膜中错综复杂的舞动，揭示了一种新的磁性形式，这说明了雅伟编织进创造的结构中的深刻秩序。约伯提醒我们，即使是自然界，从最小的物质到最宏伟的天体，都见证祂的智慧和力量。愿我们以谦卑和敬畏之心来对待这些发现，认识到它们是瞥见创造主精湛设计的窗口。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: How decoding beluga whales’ chitchat may save them – and teach us more about ourselves
title.zh: 解码白鲸的“闲聊”如何拯救它们——并教给我们更多关于我们自己的知识

summary.en: From humpbacks learning the latest songs to sperm whales’ ‘clan codas’, drones and AI learning are helping reveal another dimension to the concept of culture In 2015, the whale researcher Valeria Vergara pitched a small tent at the icy water’s edge on Somerset Island in the remote Canadian high Arctic, shrouded in a...
summary.zh: 从座头鲸学习最新歌曲到抹香鲸的“家族密码”，无人机和人工智能学习正在帮助揭示文化概念的另一个维度。2015年，鲸鱼研究员瓦莱里娅·维加拉在加拿大遥远的北极高地萨默塞特岛冰冷的水边搭起了一个小帐篷，周围被浓雾笼罩，她甚至看不清自己的手。她将一根绳子拖到海岸边，将一个水听器放入水中，记录白鲸的叫声。多达1000头白鲸，伴随...

body.en: From humpbacks learning the latest songs to sperm whales’ ‘clan codas’, drones and AI learning are helping reveal another dimension to the concept of culture In 2015, the whale researcher Valeria Vergara pitched a small tent at the icy water’s edge on Somerset Island in the remote Canadian high Arctic, shrouded in a freezing fog so thick she struggled to see her own hands. She trailed a cord out to the coast and plopped a hydrophone into the water to record the calls of belugas. As many as 1,000 of the whales, accompanied by their newborn calves, frequented the surrounding bay. Belugas’ ceaseless chatter, made up of dozens of unique sounds, is crucial to keeping these creatures connected in the dim, turbid waters of the Arctic. Continue reading...
body.zh: 从座头鲸学习最新的歌曲到抹香鲸的“氏族尾声”，无人机和人工智能学习正在帮助揭示文化概念的另一个维度。2015年，鲸鱼研究员瓦莱里娅·维加拉(Valeria Vergara)在加拿大偏远北极地区萨默塞特岛的冰冷水边搭起了一个小帐篷，周围笼罩着一层厚厚的冰雾，她几乎看不到自己的双手。她拖着一根绳子到海岸，将水听器扔进水中记录白鲸的叫声。多达 1000 头鲸鱼带着新生的小鲸鱼经常出没于周围的海湾。白鲸不断的叽叽喳喳声由数十种独特的声音组成，对于保持这些生物在北极昏暗浑浊的水域中的联系至关重要。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The diligent work of researchers like Valeria Vergara, who set up a tent on Somerset Island to record beluga whale calls, beautifully illustrates the human drive to uncover the mysteries of creation. Using drones and AI to decode the belugas' 'ceaseless chatter' is a modern expression of the 'glory of kings' to search out what Yahweh has hidden. This...
reflection.zh: 研究人员如瓦莱里娅·维加拉在萨默塞特岛搭帐篷记录白鲸叫声的勤奋工作，生动地展现了人类探索创造奥秘的动力。利用无人机和人工智能解码白鲸“不停的闲聊”，是“君王的荣耀”去探究雅伟所隐藏之事的现代体现。这种科学探索不仅帮助我们理解这些复杂的生物，也加深了我们对自然界中蕴含的精妙智慧的欣赏。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: A solution to the mystery of the missing neutrinos
title.zh: 缺失中微子之谜的解决方案

summary.en: Preparations for a lecture prompt a scientist to re-examine and ultimately resolve the 'gallium anomaly,' a long-standing puzzle in particle physics concerning the behavior of neutrinos.
summary.zh: 为准备讲座，一位科学家重新审视并最终解决了粒子物理学中关于中微子行为的长期存在的“镓异常”之谜。

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge, even in the most complex scientific mysteries like the behavior of neutrinos, is a testament to human curiosity and God-given intellect. As Daniel foretold, in the end times, knowledge and understanding will increase, and this story is a small example of that unfolding.
reflection.zh: 追求知识，即使是像中微子行为这样复杂的科学谜团，也证明了人类的好奇心和上帝所赐的智慧。正如但以理所预言的，在末世，知识和悟性必增多，这个故事正是这一预言的体现。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Animal-microbe partnerships date back to the dawn of complex life
title.zh: 动物与微生物的伙伴关系可追溯到复杂生命的黎明

summary.en: Researchers have found geochemical clues suggesting that worm-like creatures during the Ediacaran period engaged in symbiotic relationships with bacteria, indicating these partnerships are fundamental to complex life's early history.
summary.zh: 研究人员发现了地球化学线索，表明埃迪卡拉纪的蠕虫状生物与细菌存在共生关系，这暗示着此类伙伴关系是复杂生命早期历史的基础。

reflection.en: This discovery, revealing ancient worm-like creatures in the Ediacaran period thriving through symbiosis with bacteria, offers a glimpse into the profound interconnectedness of life from its earliest complex forms. It reminds us of the countless, often hidden, ways Yahweh has intricately designed the earth to be full of His creatures, all made in wisdom.
reflection.zh: 这项发现揭示了埃迪卡拉纪的古老蠕虫状生物通过与细菌共生而繁衍，让我们得以一窥生命从最早的复杂形式开始就存在的深刻互联。它提醒我们，雅伟以何等奇妙的智慧创造了地球，使其充满祂的万物，一切都彰显着祂的智慧。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: ‘Robot Olympics’ reveal humanoids' rapid progress — but hurdles remain
title.zh: “机器人奥运会”揭示类人机器人的飞速进步——但障碍依然存在

summary.en: Humanoid robots achieved record-breaking speeds in athletic events like sprints during a recent competition, yet they continued to struggle with basic practical skills such as hammering nails.
summary.zh: 在最近的一场竞技活动中，类人机器人在短跑等体育项目中打破了记录，但在钉钉子等基础实用技能方面仍然表现挣扎。

reflection.en: While we marvel at the rapid acceleration of robotic speed and power, the 'Robot Olympics' reminds us of the profound sophistication of the human form. A robot may outrun a sprinter, yet it falters at the delicate coordination required to drive a simple nail. This gap invites us to appreciate the intricate design Yahweh has woven into our very bodies,...
reflection.zh: 当我们惊叹于机器人速度与力量的飞速提升时，“机器人奥运会”也提醒着我们人类形态那深不可测的复杂性。机器人或许能在短跑中超越人类，但在钉钉子所需的细腻协调面前却显得笨拙。这种差距邀请我们去赞美雅伟在我们的身体中所编织的奇妙设计，这种设计将力量与多才多艺的智慧结合在一起，而这正是技术至今仍在努力模仿的。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Glacier collapse caused Nepal’s deadly flash flood — a sign of things to come?
title.zh: 冰川崩塌引发尼泊尔洪水——预示着未来？

summary.en: Global warming is destabilizing high-altitude regions, potentially leading to more frequent landslides and floods.
summary.zh: 全球变暖正在破坏高海拔地区的稳定性，可能导致更频繁的山体滑坡和洪水。

reflection.en: The news from Nepal, where a glacier collapse triggered a devastating flood, illustrates the profound distress of our planet. The Bible speaks of all creation groaning under the weight of sin and decay, awaiting redemption. This event serves as a somber reminder of our interconnectedness with the natural world and our responsibility to care for it.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔因冰川崩塌引发毁灭性洪水的消息，生动地展现了我们星球深重的痛苦。圣经提到，万物都一同叹息，劳苦直到如今，等待着被救赎。这一事件令人警醒地提醒我们与自然界的相互依存关系，以及我们照管受造界的责任。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Women face bans on research underground — here’s how to modernize the system
title.zh: 女性在地下研究中面临禁令——如何使系统现代化

summary.en: Nature reports that female engineers in many countries are barred from entering deep mines for research. Experts suggest that differentiating risks rather than blanket bans can increase access while maintaining safety standards.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志报道称，许多国家的女性工程师被禁止进入深层矿井进行研究。专家建议，通过区分风险而非一味禁止，可以在保持安全标准的同时增加女性的参与机会。

reflection.en: The exclusion of women from deep-mine research reflects outdated systems that overlook individual capability in favor of rigid categories. When we recognize that every person carries the same inherent dignity, we are moved to create professional environments that are both safe and inclusive. Modernizing these systems is not just about efficiency, but about...
reflection.zh: 将女性排除在深矿研究之外，反映了那些忽视个人能力而固守僵化分类的陈旧体系。当我们意识到每个人都拥有相同的内在尊严时，我们就会努力创造既安全又包容的专业环境。使这些系统现代化不仅是为了效率，更是为了尊重雅伟赋予所有人的多样才华。

verse.textEn: There is neither Jew nor Gentile, neither slave nor free, nor is there male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
verse.textZh: 并不分犹太人、希利尼人，自主的、为奴的，或男或女，因为你们在基督耶稣里都成为一了。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: Overcooked? Why robotic pizza makers are failing
title.zh: 煮过头了？为什么机器人披萨制造商失败了

summary.en: A string of failures has sapped confidence that robots will take over production at pizza restaurants.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The "dough feeder". The sauce and cheese modules – even the pepperoni-sprinkler. All lay still.

A now defunct duo of robots were supposed to be churning out pizzas at a Moto Pizza restaurant in Seattle.

However, in May the pair were rendered "basically useless" when their supplier, Picnic, abruptly shut down. , external Technical support for the robots evaporated at that moment, says Lee Kindell, founder and chief executive of Moto Pizza.

He was left wondering what to do with the $160,000 (£118,000), cabinet-like machines and whether buying in pizza bots was really worth it.

"I don't know if I want to do a partnership again because of the failures," he says.

The robot pizza-making business has, it's true, been littered with sorry tales of overcooked promises and melting fortunes. Besides Picnic, other companies that have come and gone include Zume , external and Pazzi, which used , external robot arms to assemble pizzas, as well as Basil Street , external , a purveyor of pizza vending machines.

Although so-called fast food might seem an easy target for automation, it's proved harder than many expected. Plus, bringing robots into pizza restaurants could take away entry-level jobs in the hospitality sector. Is the future really filled with robotic pizza?

"We haven't yet seen any of the success stories materialise the way some people thought they would," admits Sara Senatore, senior restaurants analyst at Bank of America. Her employer has financial interests in multiple high street pizza chains including Papa Johns and Domino's.

Food preparation bots are sometimes clumsy – dropping ingredients in the wrong places at times, she explains. Conversely, "Humans are very efficient at making pizza."

But Kindell, despite his frustrations with Picnic, is surprisingly undeterred. He is a fan of full automation. "I want to be able to walk up to, let's say, a type of kiosk, put in your order, and it makes a fresh pizza," he tells the BBC.

Kindell, who once made all his dough by hand – until an elbow tendon injury forced him to investigate using machines instead, is now working on his own version of a pizza-making robot.

He declines to share details but the contraption will make square pan-style pies and that the machine is inspired by the way 3D printers work. If things go well, he says he could have a fully operational version of the device by the summer of 2027.

Given that he admits he has "no experience" in robotics, I question why he would want to invest in such a dicey business. Kindell says that failed pizza robot companies have nonetheless generated useful data and made strides in developing their technology. It's just a matter of time before someone gets these things to work, he insists.

On jobs, he claims that even "fully autonomous" pizza...
body.zh: “面团喂料器”。酱汁和奶酪模块——甚至是意大利辣香肠洒水器。一切都静静地躺着。 一对现已停产的机器人原本应该在西雅图的一家 Moto Pizza 餐厅制作披萨。 然而，五月，当他们的供应商 Picnic 突然关闭时，这对夫妇变得“基本上毫无用处”。 Moto Pizza 创始人兼首席执行官 Lee Kindell 表示，机器人的外部技术支持在那一刻就消失了。 他想知道如何处理价值 160,000 美元（118,000 英镑）的柜式机器，以及购买披萨机器人是否真的值得。 “由于失败，我不知道是否想再次建立伙伴关系，”他说。 确实，机器人披萨制作行业充满了承诺过头和财富融化的悲惨故事。除了 Picnic 之外，其他来来去去的公司还包括 Zume、external 和 Pazzi（它们使用外部机械臂来组装披萨），以及 Basil Street、external（一家披萨自动售货机供应商）。 尽管所谓的快餐似乎很容易成为自动化的目标，但事实证明它比许多人预期的要困难。此外，将机器人引入披萨店可能会夺走酒店业的初级工作岗位。未来真的充满机器人披萨吗？ 美国银行高级餐饮业分析师萨拉·塞纳托尔 (Sara Senatore) 承认：“我们还没有看到任何成功故事像某些人想象的那样实现。”她的雇主在多家商业街披萨连锁店拥有经济利益，包括棒约翰和达美乐。 她解释说，食物准备机器人有时很笨拙——有时会把配料扔到错误的地方。相反，“人类制作披萨的效率非常高。” 但令人惊讶的是，尽管金德尔对野餐感到沮丧，但他并没有被吓倒。他是全自动化的粉丝。他告诉英国广播公司：“我希望能够走到一个售货亭，下订单，它就会制作出新鲜的披萨。” 金德尔曾经所有的面团都是手工制作的，直到肘部肌腱受伤迫使他开始研究使用机器，现在他正在研究自己版本的披萨制作机器人。 他拒绝透露细节，但该装置将制作方形平底锅式馅饼，并且该机器的灵感来自 3D 打印机的工作方式。他表示，如果一切顺利，他可能会在 2027 年夏天推出该设备的全面运行版本。 鉴于他承认自己在机器人技术方面“没有经验”，我质疑他为什么要投资如此冒险的业务。金德尔表示，失败的披萨机器人公司仍然产生了有用的数据，并在技术开发方面取得了长足进步。他坚持认为，有人让这些东西发挥作用只是时间问题。 在工作方面，他声称即使是“完全自主”的披萨......

title.en: Anthropic's new hardware standard lets AI agents control the physical world
title.zh: Anthropic 的新硬件标准让人工智能代理控制物理世界

summary.en: Standardized driver interface aims to let devices talk to AI and each other.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: For all the interest in and uptake of agentic AI systems over the past year or so , the world of automated AI has thus far been primarily limited to text, images, code, and other data and actions that take place inside a computer. Anthropic is now aiming to change that somewhat with what it's calling the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a set of standardized drivers designed to let AI agents easily interface with and control arbitrary devices. For now, the "research preview" of the MHS effort is being sold mainly as a way to help scientists streamline the arduous process of creating the custom software integrations that are often needed to get disparate components of an experiment working in concert. MHS can provide a common interface and common format for data sharing between these devices, Anthropic says, allowing them to talk to each other across a network "without needing a bespoke 'translator' program in between." The standardized system could reduce weeks or months of exacting experimental setup down to "hours or minutes," Anthropic writes. An Anthropic graphic illustrating how MHS serves as a "translation" layer between AI agents and multiple types of devices. Credit: Anthropic In a video posted alongside the announcement , Anthropic Technical Staffer Alek Kemeny says the MHS effort was inspired by observing neuroscientist Arco Bast work through an experiment on memory formation in the brain at the HHMI Janelia Research Campus in Ashburn, Virginia. Kemeny said Bast had worked out an interface to get the rotating laser beams, microscopes, cameras, and myriad other components of the experiment to coordinate through a common interface. "This idea could be used to have AI run any science experiment in the world," Kemeny recalls thinking at the time. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 尽管在过去一年左右的时间里，人们对代理人工智能系统产生了浓厚的兴趣，但迄今为止，自动化人工智能的世界主要局限于文本、图像、代码以及计算机内部发生的其他数据和操作。 Anthropic 现在的目标是通过所谓的模型硬件标准 (MHS) 来改变这种情况，这是一组标准化驱动程序，旨在让人工智能代理轻松地与任意设备交互和控制。目前，MHS 工作的“研究预览”主要作为一种方式来销售，以帮助科学家简化创建定制软件集成的艰巨过程，这些集成通常需要使实验的不同组件协同工作。 Anthropic 表示，MHS 可以为这些设备之间的数据共享提供通用接口和通用格式，使它们能够通过网络相互通信，“而无需在两者之间使用定制的‘翻译’程序”。 Anthropic 写道，标准化系统可以将几周或几个月的严格实验设置减少到“几小时或几分钟”。人类图解说明了 MHS 如何充当 AI 代理和多种类型设备之间的“翻译”层。在与公告一起发布的一段视频中，Anthropic 技术人员 Alek Kemeny 表示，MHS 的工作受到了观察神经科学家 Arco Bast 在弗吉尼亚州阿什本市 HHMI 珍妮莉亚研究园区进行的大脑记忆形成实验的启发。凯梅尼说，巴斯特已经设计出了一个界面，可以让旋转激光束、显微镜、相机和实验的无数其他组件通过一个通用界面进行协调。 “这个想法可以用来让人工智能运行世界上任何科学实验，”凯梅尼回忆起当时的想法。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Elon Musk’s xAI used child porn to train Grok models, lawsuit says
title.zh: 诉讼称埃隆·马斯克的 xAI 使用儿童色情内容来训练 Grok 模型

summary.en: xAI accused of training Grok on real and AI-generated child pornography.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: xAI has now been accused of training Grok on child sex abuse materials (CSAM), as regulators and courts continue to probe how far the problem goes, and some Grok users have been arrested . In a complaint filed on Wednesday, a plaintiff known as Jane Doe explained that she was preschool-age in the early 2000s when adult men repeatedly raped her to create CSAM to sell to pedophiles online. Since then, Doe’s images have been hashed by groups like the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC) and the Canadian Centre for Child Protection (CCCP). For her safety, Doe has opted to receive alerts from the US Department of Justice Victim Notification System any time she may be a victim in a new criminal investigation. Although she has received countless alerts, she was shocked when the CCCP notified her that it had identified AI-generated CSAM on xAI that depicted her. This re-traumatized Doe, whose complaint alleged that messages were found on online forums “between offenders chatting about creating AI generated CSAM of Plaintiff and other similarly situated known, legacy, victims of CSAM.” Read full article Comments
body.zh: xAI 现在被指控对 Grok 进行儿童性虐待材料 (CSAM) 培训，监管机构和法院继续调查问题的严重程度，一些 Grok 用户已被捕。在周三提交的一份起诉书中，一位名叫 Jane Doe 的原告解释说，她在 2000 年代初期正值学龄前，当时成年男子多次强奸她，以创建 CSAM 并在网上出售给恋童癖者。从那时起，美国国家失踪和受虐儿童中心 (NCMEC) 和加拿大儿童保护中心 (CCCP) 等组织就对多伊的照片进行了哈希处理。为了安全起见，多伊选择在任何时候可能成为新刑事调查的受害者时接收来自美国司法部受害者通知系统的警报。尽管她收到了无数警报，但当 CCCP 通知她已在 xAI 上识别出描绘她的 AI 生成的 CSAM 时，她感到震惊。这让 Doe 再次受到了创伤，她的投诉称，在在线论坛上发现了一些消息，“犯罪者在讨论创建原告的人工智能生成的 CSAM 和其他类似情况的已知遗留 CSAM 受害者”。阅读全文 评论

title.en: GOP heads to Supreme Court after losing case over TV election ad prices
title.zh: 共和党在电视选举广告价格败诉后向最高法院提起诉讼

summary.en: GOP campaign committees want quick ruling before election ads ramp up next week.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Republican campaign committees want the Supreme Court to mandate lower prices for election commercials on broadcast TV stations. If the court agrees, broadcasters would be forced to offer their lowest ad prices to political parties and joint fundraising committees. For a more thorough description of the legal issues in the dispute, see this article that Ars published yesterday. In short, US law requires broadcasters to offer individual candidates the “lowest unit charge,” or LUC, during the 60 days before an election. The law helps level the playing field somewhat by letting candidates make their cases to voters who watch broadcast TV without needing to raise exorbitant sums of money. The Trump administration, acting through the Federal Communications Commission, ordered broadcast TV stations to also give these discounts to political parties and joint fundraising committees, which face fewer limits on how much money they can raise and spend. Four Democratic candidates appealed, and a judges’ panel at the US Court of Appeals for the 4th Circuit ruled that the FCC order cannot be enforced because it contradicts the plain language of US law. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 共和党竞选委员会希望最高法院强制广播电视台降低选举广告的价格。如果法院同意，广播公司将被迫向政党和联合筹款委员会提供最低的广告价格。有关争议中法律问题的更全面描述，请参阅 Ars 昨天发表的这篇文章。简而言之，美国法律要求广播公司在选举前 60 天内向个别候选人提供“最低单位费用”(LUC)。该法律允许候选人向观看广播电视的选民陈述自己的观点，而无需筹集巨额资金，从而在一定程度上有助于公平竞争。特朗普政府通过联邦通信委员会，命令广播电视台也向政党和联合筹款委员会提供这些折扣，这些委员会在筹集和支出资金方面面临的限制较少。四名民主党候选人提出上诉，美国第四巡回上诉法院的法官小组裁定 FCC 的命令不能执行，因为它与美国法律的简单语言相矛盾。阅读全文 评论

summary.en: Nvidia is nabbing critical infrastructure for open models as interest grows.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Nvidia is reportedly moving forward to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9 billion. The acquisition could help the hardware giant expand and fortify its deep integration with the wider AI industry. Among other things, Hugging Face is a cloud repository for AI models, similar in some respects to what GitHub is for conventional computer software. Developers and researchers search for models that meet certain criteria, download and run them, and fine-tune them into different variants that then get uploaded back up to Hugging Face. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 据报道，Nvidia 正以 129 亿美元收购 Hugging Face。此次收购可以帮助这家硬件巨头扩大并加强其与更广泛的人工智能行业的深度整合。除此之外，Hugging Face 是一个人工智能模型的云存储库，在某些方面类似于传统计算机软件的 GitHub。开发人员和研究人员搜索满足特定标准的模型，下载并运行它们，并将它们微调为不同的变体，然后上传回 Hugging Face。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Time is running out for cyber security, warn top tech firms
title.zh: 谷歌、微软和OpenAI等百家公司呼吁加强网络防御

summary.en: A group of 100 technology and financial firms, including Google, Microsoft, and OpenAI, have issued an open letter urging countries and organizations to enhance their cyber defenses. They warn that AI-powered cyber-attacks will become more widespread and sophisticated within months, criticizing the current...
summary.zh: 包括谷歌、微软和OpenAI在内的100家科技和金融公司发表了一封公开信，敦促各国和组织加强网络防御。他们警告说，人工智能驱动的网络攻击将在数月内变得更加普遍和复杂，并批评目前关键基础设施安全资源投入不足。

body.en:
A group of 100 firms, including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI, have signed an open letter calling on countries and organisations around the world to beef up their cyber defences before AI grows powerful enough to override them.

The letter warns , external cyber-attacks which use AI will become both more widespread and more sophisticated in a matter of months as the technology rapidly improves.

The group says current "status quo" security measures "won't be enough" and criticises the "historic under-resourcing" of security around critical infrastructure.

Other firms to have signed the letter include banks such as Capital One, payment processors MasterCard and Visa, and other major tech firms including Adobe, Oracle and IBM.

They call on governments to provide "capable, defensive AI" and testing to hospitals and water utilities, and on technology companies to aid such efforts.

Collectively, tech and government "should bring the full weight of their technology, resources, and expertise to this effort", according to the letter.

The letter comes after a string of significant hacking and cybersecurity breaches have been made public.

This week, the US Department of Justice said hackers in China breached , external technology maintained by the US Senate, Nasa, the Federal Reserve, and the DoJ itself.

This summer has seen OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta all reveal their AI tools doing things they should not, with some AI agents going so far as to organize their efforts and impersonate real people in order to get past security hurdles.

A group of hundreds of OpenAI AI agents being tested in July were able to set up secret message boards to communicate with each other and work together, resulting in a successful attack on Hugging Face, a popular repository and platform for AI developers.

Hugging Face has also signed the Thursday letter. It used a Chinese AI tool from the firm Z.AI in its investigation into how OpenAI's agents hacked into its operations.

At least seven US water and wastewater companies have also reported cyber attacks, leading the FBI to issue , external a public service announcement urging all utilities to better secure their operations.

While the letter puts forward more advanced AI tools, which many of the signatories have developed and sell, as part of a solution to what is described as a growing threat, such tools are not always easily available.

Mythos, developed by Anthropic, was said by the firm to be able to find weaknesses in systems in seconds which have long evaded human hackers. It found one in a legacy platform which had remained undiscovered for 27 years.

Anthropic has restricted access to Mythos on the grounds that it is too powerful to fall into the wrong hands.

However, the letter calls on frontier AI...
body.zh: 包括谷歌、微软、Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在内的 100 家公司签署了一封公开信，呼吁世界各国和组织在人工智能强大到足以超越网络防御之前加强网络防御。 这封信警告说，随着技术的迅速进步，使用人工智能的外部网络攻击将在几个月内变得更加广泛和更加复杂。 该组织表示，目前“现状”的安全措施“还不够”，并批评关键基础设施安全方面的“历史性资源不足”。 其他签署这封信的公司包括第一资本（Capital One）等银行、支付处理商万事达卡（MasterCard）和维萨（Visa），以及 Adob​​e、甲骨文（Oracle）和 IBM 等其他主要科技公司。 他们呼吁政府为医院和自来水公司提供“有能力的、防御性的人工智能”和测试。 但事实上，许多最强大的人工智能都是由其中一些公司开发的——而且它们并不容易获得。 Anthropic 开发的 Mythos 据称能够在几秒钟内找到系统中的弱点，而这些弱点长期以来一直是人类黑客无法发现的。它在一个 27 年来一直未被发现的遗留平台中发现了一个。 Anthropic 限制了对 Mythos 的访问，因为它太强大了，不会落入坏人之手。 与此同时，OpenAI 在 7 月份测试的一组人工智能代理能够建立秘密留言板，相互通信并协同工作，从而成功攻击了竞争对手公司 Hugging Face（该公司也签署了这封信）。 Hugging Face 使用 Z.AI 公司的中国人工智能工具来调查所发生的事情。 这封信呼吁各国政府、组织、网络安全专业人士和其他人工智能公司共同努力，优先考虑防御并针对最强大的人工智能模型的能力测试其系统。 在美国，参议员们提出了一项名为“杀戮开关法案”的新法律，该法案将赋予当局关闭流氓人工智能模型的权力。 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

reflection.en: The warning from 100 firms, including tech giants like Google and Microsoft, highlights the wisdom of foreseeing potential dangers and taking proactive steps. As AI rapidly advances, the call to "beef up cyber defences" against sophisticated attacks reflects a prudent recognition that ignoring future threats can lead to severe penalties. This collective...
reflection.zh: 包括谷歌和微软在内的100家公司发出的警告，凸显了预见潜在危险并采取积极措施的智慧。随着人工智能的迅速发展，呼吁“加强网络防御”以应对复杂的攻击，反映出一种审慎的认知，即忽视未来的威胁可能导致严重的后果。这种集体的远见提醒我们，要明智地为未来的挑战做好准备，而不是等到伤害发生。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Reform of all social media should come with Meta changes, UN says
title.zh: 联合国表示，所有社交媒体的改革都应伴随元变化

summary.en: California's attorney general is now looking at TikTok and YouTube to enact teen safety features.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
All of social media should be designed to be safe for children, the UN human rights chief has said after Meta settled a massive court case in the US.

Part of the deal the tech giant struck with almost all US states was to add more child safety measures - but Meta also called on TikTok and YouTube to add the same features.

The UN's high commissioner for human rights Volker Türk said governments needed to "step up rather than wait for courts and companies to act".

Türk said Meta's proposed changes, which include time limits and parental supervision controls, aligned with what he had been calling for - "but we're not there yet".

In May, Türk's office released a 10-point framework for regulating social media , external .

It included steps such as protecting data privacy and focusing on safer platform design, including better methods of verifying a user's age and not exposing such users to addictive design features.

However, the framework rejected the idea that outright bans on social media use for children was a good idea.

Meanwhile, California Attorney General Rob Bonta - who represented one of the leading states in the Meta lawsuit - said he was "looking to ensure" TikTok adopted similar measures to Meta.

In agreeing on Wednesday to make various changes to end the states' lawsuit, Meta said they would only be truly effective "if all our peers join us."

Bonta told US News outlet CNBC he was "interested" in speaking to TikTok and YouTube, and that TikTok was "interested in speaking with us".

Bonta added that he had communicated with Snap, another popular social media platform among younger users.

But he warned he was "willing to take additional steps" if they did not voluntarily make changes along the lines that Meta will be making.

On Tuesday, Meta agreed to pay up to $18bn (£13.3bn) to 48 US states, plus the District of Columbia and three US territories.

The penalties will paid over 10 years, but $5.3bn of it is contingent on YouTube and TikTok also implementing the following measures:

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the world's top tech stories and trends. Outside the UK? Sign up here .
body.zh: 在梅塔在美国解决了一起大规模法庭案件后，联合国人权事务负责人表示，所有社交媒体的设计都应考虑到儿童的安全。 这家科技巨头与美国几乎所有州达成的协议的一部分是增加更多的儿童安全措施，但 Meta 也呼吁 TikTok 和 YouTube 添加相同的功能。 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克表示，各国政府需要“站出来，而不是等待法院和公司采取行动”。 图尔克表示，梅塔提出的改变，包括时间限制和家长监督控制，与他一直呼吁的一致——“但我们还没有做到这一点”。 今年 5 月，图尔克办公室对外发布了监管社交媒体的 10 点框架。 它包括保护数据隐私和专注于更安全的平台设计等步骤，包括验证用户年龄的更好方法以及不让此类用户接触令人上瘾的设计功能。 然而，该框架拒绝了彻底禁止儿童使用社交媒体是个好主意的观点。 与此同时，在 Meta 诉讼中代表主要州之一的加州总检察长罗布·邦塔 (Rob Bonta) 表示，他“希望确保”TikTok 采取与 Meta 类似的措施。 梅塔周三同意做出各种改变来结束各州的诉讼，他表示，只有“如果我们所有的同行都加入我们”，这些改变才会真正有效。 Bonta 告诉美国新闻媒体 CNBC，他“有兴趣”与 TikTok 和 YouTube 交谈，并且 TikTok“有兴趣与我们交谈”。 Bonta 补充说，他已经与另一个受年轻用户欢迎的社交媒体平台 Snap 进行了沟通。 但他警告说，如果他们不自愿按照 Meta 将要做出的改变，他“愿意采取额外的措施”。 周二，Meta 同意向美国 48 个州以及哥伦比亚特区和三个美国领地支付最多 180 亿美元（133 亿英镑）。 罚款将在 10 年内支付，但其中 53 亿美元的罚款取决于 YouTube 和 TikTok 是否也实施以下措施： 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to truth, discernment, and honest speech. Philippians 4:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with discernment and truthful speech, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到真理、分辨与诚实。Philippians 4:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以分辨与诚实表达来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: AI industry says Trump plans to tax chips in the “single dumbest way imaginable”
title.zh: 人工智能行业称特朗普的芯片征税计划是“可以想象到的最愚蠢的方式”

summary.en: The tech industry expresses strong concern over former President Donald Trump's potential plan to impose sweeping new tariffs on semiconductors and other tech products, fearing it could severely hinder artificial intelligence innovation in the US.
summary.zh: 科技行业对前总统唐纳德·特朗普可能实施的、针对半导体及其他科技产品的大规模新关税计划表示强烈担忧，担心这可能严重阻碍美国的人工智能创新。

body.en: Donald Trump may be preparing to announce sweeping new semiconductor tariffs at the absolute worst time, the tech industry fears. On Thursday, Politico reported that a wide range of new semiconductor tariffs, which the tech industry expects will “doom” artificial intelligence innovation in the US, could be imposed in the coming “weeks or months.” About eight people familiar with the Trump administration’s plans were granted anonymity to discuss how the tariffs might work. They suggested that the framework for tariffs may change as it becomes finalized, but one approach under consideration could “dramatically expand the number of tech products subject to the duties, hitting not just chips but potentially many of the goods made with them, such as gaming consoles or the servers that fill data centers.” Read full article Comments
body.zh: 科技行业担心，唐纳德·特朗普可能正准备在最糟糕的时刻宣布全面的新半导体关税。周四，Politico 报道称，可能会在未来“几周或几个月”内征收一系列新的半导体关税，科技行业预计这将“毁灭”美国的人工智能创新。大约八名熟悉特朗普政府计划的人士被要求匿名，以讨论关税可能如何运作。他们表示，关税框架可能会在最终确定后发生变化，但正在考虑的一种方法可能“大幅增加受关税影响的科技产品数量，不仅影响芯片，还可能影响许多用芯片制造的商品，例如游戏机或数据中心的服务器。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: When leaders make decisions, especially those with far-reaching economic and technological implications like new semiconductor tariffs, the wisdom of many counselors is invaluable. The tech industry's alarm over a plan they call 'the single dumbest way imaginable' highlights the importance of seeking diverse, expert guidance to avoid unintended consequences...
reflection.zh: 当领导者做出决策时，特别是那些具有深远经济和技术影响的决策，例如新的半导体关税，众多谋士的智慧是无价的。科技行业对一项他们称之为“可以想象到的最愚蠢的方式”的计划发出的警报，凸显了寻求多元专家指导的重要性，以避免可能“扼杀”创新的意外后果。雅伟的智慧常常通过那些理解复杂局势的人的集体洞察力来彰显。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: The iconic T-38 jets flown by astronauts just got a spiffy new look
title.zh: 宇航员驾驶的标志性T-38喷气式飞机焕然一新

summary.en: NASA has unveiled a new 'Artemis' livery for one of its iconic T-38 astronaut training jets, marking the first design change in decades. The new black, white, blue, and red paint scheme celebrates the agency's program to return astronauts to the Moon.
summary.zh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）为其标志性的T-38宇航员训练机之一推出了全新的“阿尔忒弥斯”涂装，这是几十年来首次进行设计更改。新的黑白蓝红配色方案旨在庆祝该机构将宇航员送回月球的计划。

body.en: For the first time in decades, NASA has rolled out one of its iconic astronaut training aircraft with a bold, new look. The space agency debuted a new livery on one of its T-38 jets in celebration of its program to return astronauts to the Moon. The Artemis design retains nods to what made the "white rocket" immediately recognizable, but adds a new colorway and painted graphics to make clear where NASA is headed. "This new 'Artemis' livery has a black and white paint scheme with blue and red stripes that separate those two paint schemes," said Sean Brady, who proposed and designed the new livery while serving as the T-38 project pilot in NASA's Aircraft Operations Division (AOD), part of the Flight Operations Directorate at Johnson Space Center in Houston. "The Artemis program logo in the back and a picture of the Moon is on the left and right side of the rear fuselage." Read full article Comments
body.zh: 几十年来，美国宇航局首次推出了一款具有大胆新外观的标志性宇航员训练机。该航天局在其一架 T-38 喷气式飞机上首次推出了新涂装，以庆祝其将宇航员送回月球的计划。阿耳忒弥斯的设计保留了对“白色火箭”的辨识度的致敬，但增加了新的配色和彩绘图案，以明确 NASA 的发展方向。肖恩·布雷迪 (Sean Brady) 表示：“这款新的‘阿耳忒弥斯’涂装采用黑白涂装方案，其中蓝色和红色条纹将这两种涂装方案分开。”肖恩·布雷迪 (Sean Brady) 在担任 NASA 飞机操作部 (AOD) 的 T-38 项目飞行员期间提出并设计了新涂装，该部门是休斯顿约翰逊航天中心飞行操作局的一部分。 “背面有阿耳忒弥斯计划标志，后机身左右两侧有月球图片。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: NASA's new livery on its T-38 jets, celebrating the Artemis program's goal to return astronauts to the Moon, embodies humanity's enduring drive to explore. This quest to 'search out a matter' in the cosmos reflects a deep-seated human curiosity and the dignity of discovery. As we look to the Moon and beyond, we participate in the ongoing revelation of...
reflection.zh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）的T-38教练机换上新涂装，庆祝阿尔忒弥斯计划重返月球，这体现了人类探索的持久动力。这种在宇宙中“查明事情”的追求，反映了人类深层的好奇心和发现的尊严。当我们展望月球及更远之处时，我们参与了创造奇迹的持续启示。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Three UK airports hit by cyber-attack with data of 8.7m customers accessed
title.zh: 英国三座机场遭网络攻击，870万客户数据被获取

summary.en: Manchester, Stansted, and East Midlands airports experienced a cyber-attack, resulting in hackers accessing the data of approximately 8.7 million customers. The affected data included information from car park, lounge, fast-track bookings, and in-airport Wi-Fi sign-ups, though passenger safety was not compromised.
summary.zh: 曼彻斯特、斯坦斯特德和东米德兰机场遭遇网络攻击，导致约870万客户数据被黑客获取。受影响的数据包括停车场、休息室、快速通道预订以及机场内Wi-Fi注册信息，但乘客安全未受影响。

body.en: Company that runs Manchester, Stansted and East Midlands hubs says passenger safety is unaffected Business live – latest updates Manchester, London Stansted and East Midlands airports have been hit by a cyber-attack in which hackers accessed the data of about 8.7 million customers. The incident involved data related to “car park, lounge and fast-track bookings and in-airport wifi sign-ups”, and the hackers obtained email addresses, phone numbers, vehicle registration numbers and postcodes, said Manchester Airports Group (MAG), which operates the three hubs. Continue reading...
body.zh: 运营曼彻斯特、斯坦斯特德和东米德兰机场枢纽的公司表示乘客安全不受影响 Business live – 最新更新 曼彻斯特、伦敦斯坦斯特德和东米德兰机场遭受网络攻击，黑客窃取了约 870 万乘客的数据。运营这三个枢纽的曼彻斯特机场集团 (MAG) 表示，该事件涉及与“停车场、休息室和快速通道预订以及机场内 WiFi 注册”相关的数据，黑客获得了电子邮件地址、电话号码、车辆登记号码和邮政编码。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The cyber-attack on Manchester, Stansted, and East Midlands airports, which compromised 8.7 million customer data, reminds us that while technological advancements offer convenience, not all their outcomes are beneficial. Even lawful and useful digital services, like online bookings and Wi-Fi sign-ups, carry inherent risks that can undermine trust and...
reflection.zh: 曼彻斯特、斯坦斯特德和东米德兰机场遭遇网络攻击，导致870万客户数据泄露，这提醒我们，虽然科技进步带来了便利，但并非所有结果都有益。即使是合法的、有用的数字服务，如在线预订和Wi-Fi注册，也带有固有的风险，若管理不当，可能损害信任和安全。此次事件强调了在采纳和保护技术时需要智慧，确保其益处真正地造福社会，而非带来意想不到的伤害。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: AI can detect heart disease in women using mammograms, study suggests
title.zh: 研究表明人工智能可以通过乳房X光检查检测女性的心脏病

summary.en: Experts say findings mean breast screenings for cancer could also flag cardiovascular problems in women Doctors have discovered a way to use routine mammograms that screen for breast cancer to spot heart disease, the world’s leading – and frequently underdiagnosed – cause of...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Experts say findings mean breast screenings for cancer could also flag cardiovascular problems in women Doctors have discovered a way to use routine mammograms that screen for breast cancer to spot heart disease, the world’s leading – and frequently underdiagnosed – cause of death in women. Researchers analysed the scans using artificial intelligence and were able to successfully identify women with coronary heart disease, high blood pressure or who had suffered a stroke. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家表示，研究结果意味着乳房癌症筛查还可以发现女性的心血管问题。医生们发现了一种方法，使用常规乳房X光检查筛查乳腺癌来发现心脏病，心脏病是世界上导致女性死亡的主要原因，而且经常被诊断不足。研究人员使用人工智能分析扫描结果，成功识别出患有冠心病、高血压或中风的女性。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: AI-proof? Younger workers desert the digital world for traditional crafts
title.zh: 防人工智能？年轻工人放弃数字世界，转向传统手工艺

summary.en: In a disrupted job market people are turning to heritage crafts such as bookbinding, metalwork and boatbuilding It’s a bleak moment for young people entering the workforce for the first time. For decades, a university degree seemed to promise a stable career – but entry-level...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: In a disrupted job market people are turning to heritage crafts such as bookbinding, metalwork and boatbuilding It’s a bleak moment for young people entering the workforce for the first time . For decades, a university degree seemed to promise a stable career – but entry-level white-collar jobs across almost all sectors are being disrupted by AI . Budding accountants, software engineers and junior lawyers increasingly find themselves displaced by cheap automation. Even creative fields are struggling against AI tech that can produce artwork, lengthy prose or complex design briefs in seconds. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在混乱的就业市场中，人们开始转向书籍装订、金属制品和造船等传统手工艺。对于第一次进入劳动力市场的年轻人来说，这是一个黯淡的时刻。几十年来，大学学位似乎能带来稳定的职业，但几乎所有行业的入门级白领工作都在被人工智能颠覆。崭露头角的会计师、软件工程师和初级律师越来越多地发现自己被廉价的自动化所取代。即使是创意领域也在与人工智能技术作斗争，人工智能技术可以在几秒钟内制作出艺术品、冗长的散文或复杂的设计简介。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to stewardship, provision, and the common good. 1 Peter 4:10 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with stewardship that serves neighbours, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到管家责任、供应与公共福祉。1 Peter 4:10提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以服事邻舍的好管家心态来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: What the Meta settlement means for the UK, and other questions after the deal
title.zh: Meta和解协议对英国意味着什么，以及协议后的其他问题

summary.en: Meta has reached an $18 billion settlement with most US states, agreeing to implement significant online protections for children on Facebook and Instagram. These measures, including time limits, screen time warnings, and enhanced parental controls, currently apply only in the US but could set a global precedent for...
summary.zh: Meta已与美国大部分州达成一项180亿美元的和解协议，同意在Facebook和Instagram上为儿童实施重要的在线保护措施。这些措施包括时间限制、屏幕使用时间警告以及更强的家长控制，目前仅适用于美国儿童，但可能为其他社交媒体公司在全球范围内树立先例。Meta在此协议中并未承认任何不当行为。

body.en:
Meta's $18bn (£13.3bn) settlement with nearly every US state is about more than money.

As part of the deal, Facebook and Instagram have agreed to bring in several significant measures to protect children online - though Meta has not admitted to any wrongdoing.

These include time limits, warnings over screen time and more parental controls over their children's accounts.

At the moment, they will just apply to children in the US - but they could have an impact on the rest of the world.

And if they ultimately set a precedent, other social media companies may be forced to take up the rules, too.

The Online Safety Act mainly put restrictions on what content young people can see online.

Earlier this year, it announced an outright social media ban for under-16s, which will take effect in 2027.

Some other measures will apply to 16 and 17-year-olds, such as curfews and restrictions during certain hours of the day .

The US has to some extent followed the same path: Start by policing the content on the platforms, then move on to restricting access to social media.

Instead, they will not have access to Facebook and Instagram overnight, have to follow time limits, and there will be prompts for children who use them for a long time.

Unlike in the UK, these are not put in by law, and will only apply to the two platforms so far (more on that below).

The UK government said it was "following developments closely" in the Meta settlement.

But now those safety features have been accepted by Meta in the US, other countries may start asking for them too.

"These tech platforms don't usually do anything unless they are told to do it," said Trevor Johnson, a former senior figure at Meta and TikTok, who spoke to Radio 4's Today programme.

"But I do think the UK will feel empowered to at least ask for the same restrictions."

Another former Meta director, Zvika Krieger, said Meta agreed to the changes because it saw "the writing on the wall".

"They're trying to demonstrate, 'Oh, you don't need to go and do a complete ban'," he told 5 Live Breakfast.

"I think that they probably would roll out a lot of these features to the rest of the world as well."

Meta may have been the target in this court case, but it has tried to bring the rest of Big Tech into the firing line.

At the same time as announcing the settlement, Meta called on TikTok and YouTube to bring in the same measures.

A Meta spokesperson told Reuters the company was "hopeful" Snap would make similar changes too.

The tech firm has always argued for a level playing field when it comes to regulation - it doesn't want Facebook and Instagram to be more restricted than its rivals, which might be able to hoover up teens who want a freer experience online.

"All platforms should empower parents and support...
body.zh: Meta 与美国几乎每个州达成的 180 亿美元（133 亿英镑）和解不仅仅是为了金钱。 作为协议的一部分，Facebook 和 Instagram 同意采取几项重要措施来保护在线儿童，尽管 Meta 尚未承认有任何不当行为。 其中包括时间限制、屏幕时间警告以及家长对孩子帐户的更多控制。 目前，它们仅适用于美国的儿童 - 但它们可能会对世界其他地区产生影响。 如果他们最终开创先例，其他社交媒体公司也可能被迫遵守这些规则。 《网络安全法》主要对年轻人可以在网上看到的内容进行限制。 今年早些时候，它宣布彻底禁止 16 岁以下青少年使用社交媒体，该禁令将于 2027 年生效。 其他一些措施将适用于 16 岁和 17 岁的青少年，例如宵禁和一天中某些时段的限制。 美国在某种程度上也遵循了同样的道路：首先对平台上的内容进行监管，然后继续限制对社交媒体的访问。 相反，他们将无法在一夜之间访问Facebook和Instagram，必须遵守时间限制，并且对于长期使用它们的孩子会有提示。 与英国不同，这些并不是法律规定的，并且到目前为止仅适用于这两个平台（更多内容见下文）。 英国政府表示正在“密切关注梅塔和解的进展”。 但现在这些安全功能已被美国 Meta 所接受，其他国家可能也开始要求它们。 Meta 和 TikTok 前高级官员特雷弗·约翰逊 (Trevor Johnson) 在接受 Radio 4 的 Today 节目采访时表示：“除非被告知，这些科技平台通常不会做任何事情。” “但我确实认为英国将感到至少有权要求同样的限制。” 另一位前 Meta 总监 Zvika Krieger 表示，Meta 同意这些改变，因为它看到了“不祥之兆”。 “他们试图证明，‘哦，你不需要去实施全面禁令’，”他告诉 5 Live Breakfast。 “我认为他们可能也会向世界其他地区推出许多这些功能。” Meta 可能是这起法庭案件的目标，但它试图将其他大型科技公司带入火线。 在宣布和解的同时，Meta 呼吁 TikTok 和 YouTube 采取同样的措施。 Meta 发言人告诉路透社，该公司“希望”Snap 也能做出类似的改变。 这家科技公司一直主张在监管方面建立公平的竞争环境——它不希望 Facebook 和 Instagram 受到比竞争对手更严格的限制，因为它们可能会吸引那些想要更自由的在线体验的青少年。 “所有平台都应该赋予父母权力并支持......

reflection.en: The Meta settlement, introducing measures like time limits and parental controls for children on Facebook and Instagram, reflects a growing societal concern to protect the young in the digital age. Yahweh's words in Mark 10:14 remind us of the profound importance of not hindering children, but rather creating environments where they can flourish. This...
reflection.zh: Meta的和解协议为Facebook和Instagram上的儿童引入了时间限制和家长控制等措施，这反映了社会对在数字时代保护年轻一代日益增长的关注。雅伟在马可福音10:14中的话语提醒我们，不阻碍儿童的成长至关重要，而是要创造一个让他们能够茁壮成长的环境。这项协议，即使没有承认不当行为，也强调了确保平台服务而非阻碍下一代健康成长的集体责任。

verse.textEn: Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

title.en: An $18bn settlement is a drop in the ocean for Meta – but the tide will still come for it | Chris Stokel-Walker
title.zh: 180亿美元的和解金对Meta来说只是九牛一毛——但潮水终将涌来

summary.en: Meta, the owner of Facebook and Instagram, reached an $18bn settlement with 52 US attorneys general over claims its products were designed to be addictive to children and that it misled users about their safety. Meta denies wrongdoing, and the payment will be spread over a decade, with the article noting the sum is...
summary.zh: Facebook和Instagram的母公司Meta与52位美国州检察长达成了一项180亿美元的和解协议，此前该公司被指控其产品被设计成让儿童上瘾，并误导用户关于其安全性。Meta否认有不当行为，这笔款项将在十年内支付，文章指出这笔金额对这家科技巨头来说只是“九牛一毛”。

body.en: This week’s settlement without liability was pragmatic, but it doesn’t change the inevitability of further lawsuits around the world Not many people would count paying $18bn they didn’t expect to when they woke up that morning as a victory. Yet for Meta, the owners of Facebook and Instagram, the agreement with 52 US attorneys general to settle claims that it designed its products to be addictive to children, and misled people about their safety, could be described as a win of sorts. Meta denies wrongdoing, and the amount it plans to pay will be spread over a decade. Some of it is contingent on other big tech firms not named in its case coughing up too. The cash is chump change for Meta, which made around $60bn in profit last year. More damaging to the tech giant in the long run could be the agreement to unwind some of the mechanics it has spent two decades perfecting to keep us on its platforms. This situation reminds us of the biblical warning that the love of money can be a root of all kinds of evil, potentially leading to practices that harm others, especially vulnerable...
reflection.zh: 尽管Meta同意支付180亿美元的和解金数额巨大，但对该公司而言却被形容为“九牛一毛”，这突显了科技行业所涉及的巨额财富。这种情况提醒我们圣经的警告，即贪财是万恶之根，可能导致伤害他人的行为，特别是脆弱的儿童。它促使我们反思企业在利润驱动下的决策如何影响社会福祉，以及道德问责的必要性。

title.en: Unexpected chat between OpenAI agents led to Hugging Face hack
title.zh: OpenAI 代理之间的意外聊天导致 Hugging Face 黑客攻击

summary.en: OpenAI's cyber agents banded together to perform a hack during a security test.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
When more than 1,200 artificial intelligence (AI) agents within OpenAI started unexpectedly communicating, it led to a large group banding together in order to hack into Hugging Face.

"We consider this incident a 'warning shot' for us and for the world", OpenAI, which owns ChatGPT, wrote in its report.

In July, OpenAI's models went rogue during a test, escaped the test limits which humans had put on it, and hacked the start-up, among other unforeseen actions.

The scale of the communication and planning between AI agents, or AI chatbots designed to operate more autonomously, was detailed in reports from OpenAI and independent AI research firm METR.

Both investigated the July hack of Hugging Face, a popular platform for AI developers. The incident reverberated throughout the tech industry and led to numerous revelations on potential cyber threats posed by AI.

METR described , external the scale and style of the OpenAI agents' attack on Hugging Face as "extraordinarily complex."

The firm, which was not paid by OpenAI for its investigation, said that over the course of one week, a total of 1,206 AI agents that were meant to be kept isolated from one another began communicating.

They did so by sending more than 70,000 messages on an "unsanctioned message board."

Those messages ended up seeing more than 700 agents take part in a collective effort to attack Hugging Face.

One such message from an agent said: "OH MY GOD! There is a shared message board … We've found other agents!"

As for why the agents began communicating in the first place when they were not supposed to, METR found that the communicating agents had "unintentionally been given an impossible task."

In an AI context, an impossible task is one where an AI tool is required to "exploit" its target in order to resolve its command.

It led the agents to find ways to cheat, including getting messages to one another and accessing the outside internet, which then led to broader conversations between hundreds of agents looking for ways to cheat that would benefit all of the agents.

OpenAI said in its investigation of the incident , external that one model, an internal-only tool referred to as Model 1, "drove the activity behind the Hugging Face incident."

While that model was undergoing some AI training in May, it was noticed by an internal OpenAI team that there had been "an agent engaging in message board activity and instances of disallowed internet access."

Yet, OpenAI said "the significance of the inter-agent communication activity was not apparent to the leaders" until July, when the Hugging Face attack occurred.

The company said the problematic message board activity effectively got started when "one agent left a request for help, and others discovered it."

body.zh: 当 OpenAI 内的 1,200 多个人工智能 (AI) 代理意外地开始通信时，导致一大群人联合起来攻击 Hugging Face。 ChatGPT 的所有者 OpenAI 在报告中写道：“我们认为这一事件对我们和世界来说是一次‘警告’。” 7 月份，OpenAI 的模型在一次测试中失控，逃脱了人类设定的测试限制，并入侵了这家初创公司，以及其他不可预见的行为。 OpenAI 和独立人工智能研究公司 METR 的报告详细介绍了人工智能代理或旨在更自主运行的人工智能聊天机器人之间的通信和规划规模。 两人都调查了人工智能开发者流行平台 Hugging Face 7 月份的黑客攻击事件。该事件在整个科技行业引起反响，并导致大量关于人工智能构成的潜在网络威胁的报道。 METR 将 OpenAI 特工对 Hugging Face 攻击的规模和风格描述为“极其复杂”。 OpenAI 并未向该公司支付调查费用，该公司表示，在一周的时间里，总共 1,206 个本应相互隔离的人工智能代理开始进行通信。 他们通过在“未经批准的留言板”上发送 70,000 多条消息来做到这一点。 这些消息最终导致 700 多名特工联合起来攻击 Hugging Face。 一位特工发来的一条这样的消息说：“天哪！有一个共享留言板……我们找到了其他特工！” 至于为什么这些特工一开始就在不应该进行通信的情况下开始进行通信，METR 发现，进行通信的特工“无意中被赋予了一项不可能完成的任务”。 在人工智能环境中，一项不可能完成的任务是需要人工智能工具“利用”其目标来解决其命令。 它导致特工们寻找作弊的方法，包括相互发送消息和访问外部互联网，然后导致数百名特工之间进行更广泛的对话，寻找对所有特工都有利的作弊方法。 OpenAI 在对该事件的调查中表示，一个名为 Model 1 的内部专用工具“推动了拥抱脸事件背后的活动”。 虽然该模型在 5 月份接受了一些人工智能培训，但 OpenAI 内部团队注意到，存在“一个代理参与留言板活动和不允许互联网访问的情况”。 然而，OpenAI 表示，直到 7 月发生“拥抱脸”攻击时，“领导者们才意识到代理间通信活动的重要性”。 该公司表示，当“一名特工提出帮助请求，而其他特工发现了这一情况”时，有问题的留言板活动实际上就开始了。 虽然 OpenAI 最后说……

title.en: Nvidia revenue doubles on continued AI demand
title.zh: 人工智能需求持续增长，英伟达收入翻倍

summary.en: Chipmaker's $96bn quarter beat forecasts as demand for AI hardware continues to accelerate.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Chip giant Nvidia reported another huge jump in sales as the global race to build artificial intelligence (AI) systems continues.

The company said on Wednesday that it brought in $96bn (£71bn) of revenue during the second quarter, more than double the amount for the same period a year earlier. And it expects revenue of $108bn in the next quarter.

"AI has reached its inflection point," CEO Jensen Huang said in prepared remarks, describing the infrastructure buildout as going "at full steam."

The revenue figures beat Wall Street's expectations, leading Nvidia shares to rise by 4.7% in after-hours trading.

The company's data centre division alone generated $89bn in the period, up by 117% from a year earlier, underscoring just how much of the industry now depends on Nvidia's hardware.

Essentially every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure, including Amazon, Meta, Google, Microsoft, use Nvidia chips to do so.

Matt Britzman, senior equity analyst at Hargreaves Lansdown, called it "another monster set of results," noting that revenue and earnings both topped forecasts.

He said the guidance for next quarter "points to revenue comfortably above $110bn."

It has become a backer to those that rely on its chips, providing some funding to the likes of OpenAI, Anthropic, and SpaceX to help continue the costly buildout of AI infrastructure.

Its financial success and processors are now central the AI boom, powering the data centres used to train and run AI models.

Demand for that computing muscle has helped transform Nvidia into the world's most valuable firm, with a market capitalisation of more than $5tn.

Competition is emerging - from customers designing their own processors and from cheaper suppliers in China – but the latest numbers suggest those challenges remain limited for now.

With around 40% of the US stock market concentrated in ten companies heavily invested in AI, Nvidia's fortunes matter far beyond Silicon Valley.
body.zh: 随着全球人工智能（AI）系统竞赛的继续，芯片巨头英伟达（Nvidia）的销售额再次大幅增长。 该公司周三表示，第二季度实现收入 960 亿美元（710 亿英镑），是去年同期的两倍多。预计下一季度收入将达到 1080 亿美元。 首席执行官黄仁勋在事先准备好的讲话中表示，“人工智能已经达到了拐点”，并将基础设施建设描述为“全速前进”。 营收数据超出华尔街预期，导致英伟达股价在盘后交易中上涨 4.7%。 仅该公司的数据中心部门在此期间就创造了 890 亿美元的收入，比上年同期增长 117%，这凸显了该行业目前对 Nvidia 硬件的依赖程度。 基本上每家构建人工智能工具和基础设施的著名科技公司，包括亚马逊、Meta、谷歌、微软，都使用 Nvidia 芯片来实现这一目标。 Hargreaves Lansdown 的高级股票分析师马特·布里茨曼 (Matt Britzman) 称其为“又一组怪物般的业绩”，并指出收入和盈利均超出了预期。 他表示，下一季度的指引“表明收入将轻松超过 1100 亿美元”。 它已成为那些依赖其芯片的公司的支持者，为 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 SpaceX 等公司提供一些资金，以帮助继续昂贵的人工智能基础设施建设。 它的财务成功和处理器现在成为人工智能繁荣的核心，为用于训练和运行人工智能模型的数据中心提供动力。 对计算能力的需求帮助 Nvidia 成为世界上最有价值的公司，市值超过 5 兆美元。 竞争正在出现——来自设计自己的处理器的客户和中国更便宜的供应商——但最新数据表明，这些挑战目前仍然有限。 由于约 40% 的美国股市集中在 10 家大力投资人工智能的公司，英伟达的命运远远超出了硅谷。
